translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day of the seventh month of the third year of Qiandao the Crown Prince died.

sentences.zh: 設素幄於太子宮正廳之東。

translations.literal: A plain mourning canopy was set up east of the main hall of the Crown Prince's palace.
translations.idiomatic: A plain mourning canopy was set up east of the main hall of the Crown Prince's palace.

sentences.zh: 皇帝自內常服至幄，俟時至，易服皂襆頭、白羅衫、黑銀帶、絲鞋，就幄發哀。

translations.literal: The Emperor came from the inner palace in regular dress to the canopy; when the hour arrived, changed into black cloth cap, white gauze robe, black silver belt, and silk shoes, and at the canopy began mourning lamentation.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor came from the inner palace in regular dress to the canopy; when the hour arrived he changed into a black cloth cap, white gauze robe, black silver belt, and silk shoes, and at the canopy began mourning lamentation.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇后服素詣宮，隨時發哀，如宮中之禮。

translations.literal: That day, the Empress wore plain dress and proceeded to the palace; at the appointed time she began mourning lamentation, as in palace rites.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Empress wore plain dress and proceeded to the palace; at the appointed time she began mourning lamentation according to palace rites.

sentences.zh: 合赴陪位官並常服、吉帶入麗正門，詣宮幕次，俟時至，常服、黑帶立班。

translations.literal: Officials due to attend in supporting ranks all entered Lizheng Gate in regular dress with auspicious belts, proceeded to the palace tent, and when the hour arrived stood in formation in regular dress with black belts.
translations.idiomatic: Officials due to attend in supporting ranks all entered Lizheng Gate in regular dress with auspicious belts, proceeded to the palace tent, and when the hour arrived stood in formation in regular dress with black belts.

sentences.zh: 俟發哀畢，易吉服，退。

translations.literal: When mourning lamentation ended, they changed into auspicious dress and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning lamentation ended, they changed into auspicious dress and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 自發哀至釋服日，皇帝不視事，權禁行在音樂，仍命諸寺院聲鐘。

translations.literal: From the mourning lamentation until the day of release from mourning, the Emperor did not attend to affairs; music at the capital was provisionally forbidden, and monasteries were ordered to sound bells.
translations.idiomatic: From the mourning lamentation until the day of release from mourning, the Emperor did not attend to affairs; music at the capital was provisionally forbidden, and monasteries were ordered to sound bells.

sentences.zh: 其小斂、大斂合祭告，以本宮主管春坊官一員行禮；

translations.literal: For the minor and major encoffining announcement sacrifices, one Spring Palace official in charge of the palace would perform the rite;
translations.idiomatic: For the minor and major encoffining announcement sacrifices, one Spring Palace official in charge of the palace was to perform the rite;

sentences.zh: 其餘祭告，以諸司官行禮。

translations.literal: Other announcement sacrifices were performed by officials of the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: Other announcement sacrifices were performed by officials of the various offices.

sentences.zh: 差護喪葬事一員，左藏庫出錢二萬貫、銀五千兩、絹五千匹。

translations.literal: One official was assigned to oversee funeral matters; the Left Treasury provided twenty thousand strings of cash, five thousand taels of silver, and five thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: One official was assigned to oversee funeral matters; the Left Treasury provided twenty thousand strings of cash, five thousand taels of silver, and five thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 成服日，皇帝服期，次粗布襆頭、襽衫、腰絰、絹襯衫、白羅鞋。

translations.literal: On the day of assuming mourning garments, the Emperor wore mourning of one-year grade: next, coarse cloth cap, hemp mourning shirt, waist mourning cord, silk under-robe, and white gauze shoes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of assuming mourning garments, the Emperor wore one-year mourning dress: a coarse cloth cap, hemp mourning shirt, waist mourning cord, silk under-robe, and white gauze shoes.

sentences.zh: 六宮人不從服。

translations.literal: Women of the Six Palaces did not follow in mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: Women of the Six Palaces did not wear mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 皇太子妃及本宮人並斬衰三年。

translations.literal: The Crown Princess and palace personnel all wore fullest three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Princess and palace personnel all wore the fullest three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 文武百官成服一日而除。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials assumed mourning for one day then removed it.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials assumed mourning for one day and then removed it.

sentences.zh: 其文武合赴官及御史台、閣門、太常寺引班祗應人並服布襆頭、襽衫，腰系布帶。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials due to attend, plus the Censorate, Gatekeepers, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices ushers and attendants, all wore cloth caps and hemp mourning shirts with cloth belts at the waist.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials due to attend, together with the Censorate, Gatekeepers, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices ushers and attendants, all wore cloth caps and hemp mourning shirts with cloth belts at the waist.

sentences.zh: 本宮官僚並服齊衰三日服，臨七日而除，釋衰服後藏其服，至葬日服，葬畢而除。

translations.literal: Palace officials wore three-day grade mourning, kept vigil seven days then removed it; after laying aside mourning garments they stored them, wore them again on burial day, and removed them when burial was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Palace officials wore three-day grade mourning, kept vigil for seven days and then removed it; after laying aside mourning garments they stored them, wore them again on burial day, and removed them when burial was complete.

sentences.zh: 十二日，詔故皇太子欑所，就安穆皇后欑宮側近擇地。

translations.literal: On the twelfth day, an edict ordered selecting a site near Empress Anmu's temporary burial for the late Crown Prince's temporary burial place.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth day an edict ordered that a site be chosen near Empress Anmu's temporary burial pavilion for the late Crown Prince's temporary burial pavilion.

sentences.zh: 繼而都大主管所言：「太史局官等選到寶林院法堂堪充皇太子欑所。」

translations.literal: Subsequently the chief supervisor reported: "Officials of the Astronomical Bureau have selected the Dharma hall of Baolin Monastery as suitable for the Crown Prince's temporary burial."
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently the chief supervisor reported: "Officials of the Astronomical Bureau have selected the Dharma hall of Baolin Monastery as suitable for the Crown Prince's temporary burial pavilion.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 十三日，以皇太子薨告天地、宗廟、社稷、宮觀。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day, the Crown Prince's death was announced to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the Altar of Soil and Grain, and palace temples.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day the Crown Prince's death was announced to Heaven and Earth, the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the Altar of Soil and Grain, and palace temples.

sentences.zh: 十八日，賜諡莊文。

translations.literal: On the eighteenth day, the posthumous title Zhuang Wen was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighteenth day the posthumous title Zhuang Wen was bestowed.

sentences.zh: 閏七月一日，遣攝中書令、尚書右僕射魏杞奉諡冊、寶于皇太子靈柩前，百官常服入次，易黑帶，行禮畢，常服赴後殿門襪，進名奉慰。

translations.literal: On the first day of intercalary seventh month, Acting Director of the Secretariat and Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wei Qi was dispatched to present the posthumous book and seal before the Crown Prince's coffin; officials entered in regular dress, changed to black belts, and after the rite in regular dress proceeded to the rear palace gate wearing mourning footwrappings to submit names in condolence.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of intercalary seventh month Wei Qi, Acting Director of the Secretariat and Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was dispatched to present the posthumous book and seal before the Crown Prince's coffin; officials entered in regular dress, changed to black belts, and after the rite, still in regular dress, proceeded to the rear palace gate wearing mourning footwrappings to submit their names in condolence.

sentences.zh: 是夕，皇帝詣東宮行燒香之禮，如宮中之儀。

translations.literal: That evening, the Emperor proceeded to the Eastern Palace to perform the incense-offering rite, as in palace rites.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the Emperor proceeded to the Eastern Palace to perform the incense-offering rite according to palace ritual.

sentences.zh: 二日，出葬，宰臣葉顒等詣靈柩前行燒香之禮。

translations.literal: On the second day, for the burial procession, Chief Councillors Ye Yong et al. performed the incense-offering rite before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day, at the burial procession, Chief Councillors Ye Yong and others performed the incense-offering rite before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 興靈訖，行事官陪位，親王、南班宗室、東宮官僚入班廳下，再拜，宰臣升詣香案前，上香、酹茶、奠酒訖，舉冊官舉哀冊，讀冊官跪讀，讀訖，宰臣再拜，各降階立。

translations.literal: When the coffin had been raised, officiating officials took supporting positions; imperial princes, southern-rank clansmen, and Eastern Palace officials entered formation below the hall and bowed twice; the chief councillors ascended to the incense table, offered incense, poured tea libation, and presented wine; when finished, the book-bearer raised the lamentation book, the reader knelt and read it; when reading was finished, the chief councillors bowed twice and each descended the steps to stand.
translations.idiomatic: When the coffin had been raised, officiating officials took supporting positions; imperial princes, southern-rank clansmen, and Eastern Palace officials entered formation below the hall and bowed twice. The chief councillors ascended to the incense table, offered incense, poured a tea libation, and presented wine. The book-bearer then raised the lamentation book and the reader knelt and read it. When the reading was finished, the chief councillors bowed twice and each descended the steps to stand.

sentences.zh: 在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: All officials in attendance bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 靈柩進行，文武百僚奉辭於城外，親王、宗室並騎從至葬所。

translations.literal: The coffin proceeded; civil and military officials paid farewell outside the city; imperial princes and clansmen all rode in attendance to the burial site.
translations.idiomatic: The coffin proceeded; civil and military officials paid their farewell outside the city, and imperial princes and clansmen all rode in attendance to the burial site.

sentences.zh: 掩壙畢，辭訖，退。

translations.literal: When the grave was covered and farewell completed, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When the grave had been covered and the farewell completed, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是日，百僚進名奉慰。

translations.literal: That day, the hundred officials submitted names in condolence.
translations.idiomatic: That day the hundred officials submitted their names in condolence.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，禮部、太常寺言：「國朝典故，即無皇太子小祥典禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "In our dynasty's precedents, there is no established rite for a crown prince's xiaoxiang observance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Our dynasty's precedents contain no established rite for a crown prince's xiaoxiang observance.

sentences.zh: 今參酌討論，將來莊文太子小祥日，乞皇帝前後殿特不視事。

translations.literal: Now after deliberation and discussion, for the future xiaoxiang day of Crown Prince Zhuang Wen, we ask that the Emperor specially refrain from holding court in both the front and rear halls.
translations.idiomatic: After deliberation, we propose that on Crown Prince Zhuang Wen's future xiaoxiang day the Emperor specially refrain from holding court in both the front and rear halls.

sentences.zh: 其日，先命侍從官一員常服詣太子神坐前行奠酹禮，令本宮官僚常服陪位，奠酹畢，退。

translations.literal: On that day, first dispatch one attendant official in regular dress to perform the offering and libation rite before the Crown Prince's spirit seat; have palace officials in regular dress attend in supporting ranks; when offering and libation are finished, withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: On that day one attendant official in regular dress should first be dispatched to perform the offering and libation rite before the Crown Prince's spirit seat, with palace officials in regular dress attending in supporting ranks; when the offering and libation are finished, they withdraw.

sentences.zh: 次慶王、恭王常服赴神坐前奠酹畢，退。

translations.literal: Next, Princes Qing and Gong in regular dress proceed to the spirit seat to perform offering and libation, then withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Next Princes Qing and Gong in regular dress proceed to the spirit seat to perform offering and libation, then withdraw.

sentences.zh: 次太子妃並榮國公以下行家人禮。

translations.literal: Next, the Crown Princess and those below Prince of Rongguo perform family rites.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Crown Princess and those below Prince of Rongguo perform family rites.

sentences.zh: 至大祥日，太子妃、榮國公以下及本宮人行禮畢，焚燒神帛，衰服，間月，妃及榮國公行禫祭家人禮。」

translations.literal: On the daxiang day, when the Crown Princess, those below Prince of Rongguo, and palace personnel have finished the rites, burn the spirit silks, wear mourning garments; after an intervening month, the consort and Prince of Rongguo perform the chan sacrifice family rites."
translations.idiomatic: On the daxiang day, after the Crown Princess, those below Prince of Rongguo, and palace personnel have finished the rites, the spirit silks are burned and mourning garments worn; after an intervening month the consort and Prince of Rongguo perform the chan sacrifice family rites.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 明年七月九日大祥，是日，皇帝不視事，差簽書樞密院事梁克家詣太子宮行奠酹禮，如前儀。

translations.literal: The next year on the ninth day of the seventh month was the daxiang observance; that day the Emperor did not attend to affairs, and Liang Kejia, Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was dispatched to the Crown Prince's palace to perform the offering and libation rite, as in the previous protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, on the ninth day of the seventh month, was the daxiang observance; that day the Emperor did not attend to affairs, and Liang Kejia, Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was dispatched to the Crown Prince's palace to perform the offering and libation rite according to the previous protocol.

sentences.zh: 景獻太子，嘉定十三年八月六日薨。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Jing Xian died on the sixth day of the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Jiading.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Jing Xian died on the sixth day of the eighth month of the thirteenth year of Jiading.

sentences.zh: 其發哀制服，並如莊文太子之禮。

translations.literal: The mourning lamentation and garments all followed the rites for Crown Prince Zhuang Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The mourning lamentation and garments all followed the rites for Crown Prince Zhuang Wen.

sentences.zh: 九日，詔護喪視殯所于莊文太子欑宮之東，並依其制建造。

translations.literal: On the ninth day, an edict ordered the funeral oversight and viewing pavilion at the east of Crown Prince Zhuang Wen's temporary burial, to be constructed according to that model.
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth day an edict ordered the funeral oversight and viewing pavilion established east of Crown Prince Zhuang Wen's temporary burial pavilion, to be constructed according to that model.

sentences.zh: 九月十日，賜諡景獻，遣攝中書令、知樞密院事鄭昭先奉諡冊、寶于皇太子靈柩前，讀冊、讀寶如儀，訖，班退。

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the ninth month, the posthumous title Jing Xian was bestowed; Acting Director of the Secretariat and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zheng Zhaoxian was dispatched to present the posthumous book and seal before the Crown Prince's coffin; reading the book and reading the seal followed ritual; when finished, the formation withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day of the ninth month the posthumous title Jing Xian was bestowed; Zheng Zhaoxian, Acting Director of the Secretariat and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was dispatched to present the posthumous book and seal before the Crown Prince's coffin; the reading of the book and seal followed ritual, and when finished the formation withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至興靈日，宰臣詣皇太子柩前行禮畢，柩行。

translations.literal: On the day the coffin was raised, the chief councillors performed rites before the Crown Prince's coffin; when finished, the coffin proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the coffin was raised, the chief councillors performed rites before the Crown Prince's coffin; when finished, the coffin proceeded.

sentences.zh: 其宗室使相、南班官常服、黑帶，並赴陪位，騎從至葬所，俟掩欑畢，奉辭訖，退。

translations.literal: Imperial clansmen grand ambassadors and southern-rank officials in regular dress with black belts all attended in supporting ranks, riding in attendance to the burial site; when the temporary burial was covered and farewell completed, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen grand ambassadors and southern-rank officials in regular dress with black belts all attended in supporting ranks, riding in attendance to the burial site; when the temporary burial was covered and the farewell completed, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 其日，皇帝不視事，百司赴後殿門外立班，進名奉慰。

translations.literal: That day, the Emperor did not attend to affairs; the hundred offices stood in formation outside the rear palace gate and submitted names in condolence.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor did not attend to affairs; the hundred offices stood in formation outside the rear palace gate and submitted their names in condolence.

sentences.zh: 十四年七月二日小祥，差知樞密院事鄭昭先充奠酹官。

translations.literal: On the second day of the seventh month of the fourteenth year was the xiaoxiang observance; Zheng Zhaoxian, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was assigned as offering and libation officer.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the seventh month of the fourteenth year was the xiaoxiang observance; Zheng Zhaoxian, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was assigned as offering and libation officer.

sentences.zh: 十五年八月六日大祥。

translations.literal: On the sixth day of the eighth month of the fifteenth year was the daxiang observance.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day of the eighth month of the fifteenth year was the daxiang observance.

sentences.zh: 九月十五日，詔景獻太子几筵已徹，高平郡夫人傅氏可特封信國夫人，仍令主奉祭祀。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month, an edict stated: "Since Crown Prince Jing Xian's spirit seat has been removed, Lady Fu, Lady of Gaoping Commandery, may be specially enfeoffed as Lady of Xinguo, and is ordered to preside over sacrifices."
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day of the ninth month an edict stated: "Since Crown Prince Jing Xian's spirit seat has been removed, Lady Fu of Gaoping Commandery may be specially enfeoffed as Lady of Xinguo and ordered to preside over sacrifices."

sentences.zh: 上陵之禮。

translations.literal: Rites of visiting imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Rites of visiting imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 古者無墓祭，秦、漢以降，始有其儀。

translations.literal: In antiquity there were no tomb sacrifices; from Qin and Han downward, the rites began.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity there were no tomb sacrifices; from Qin and Han onward the rites began to appear.

sentences.zh: 至唐，復有清明設祭，朔望、時節之祀，進食、薦衣之式。

translations.literal: By Tang, there were again Qingming offerings, new and full moon and seasonal sacrifices, and the forms of presenting food and recommending garments.
translations.idiomatic: By the Tang there were again Qingming offerings, new- and full-moon and seasonal sacrifices, and the forms of presenting food and offering garments.

sentences.zh: 五代，諸陵遠者，令本州長吏朝拜，近者遣太常、宗正卿，或因行過親謁。

translations.literal: In the Five Dynasties, for distant mausoleums the local prefect was ordered to pay court; for nearby ones the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or Director of the Imperial Clan was dispatched, or the emperor personally visited while passing.
translations.idiomatic: In the Five Dynasties, for distant mausoleums the local prefect was ordered to pay court; for nearby ones the Court of Imperial Sacrifices or the Director of the Imperial Clan was dispatched, or the emperor paid a personal visit while passing by.

sentences.zh: 宋初，春秋命宗正卿朝拜安陵，乙太牢奉祠。

translations.literal: In early Song, in spring and autumn the Director of the Imperial Clan was ordered to pay court at Anling, with grand sacrificial victims for the offering.
translations.idiomatic: In early Song, in spring and autumn the Director of the Imperial Clan was ordered to pay court at Anling with grand sacrificial victims for the offering.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年，始令宮人詣陵上冬服，歲以為常。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiande, palace women were first ordered to proceed to the tombs to present winter garments, and this became annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qiande palace women were first ordered to proceed to the tombs to present winter garments, and this became annual custom.

sentences.zh: 開寶九年，太祖幸西京，過鞏縣，謁安陵奠獻。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kaibao, Taizu visited the Western Capital, passed through Gong County, and paid respects at Anling with offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Kaibao Taizu visited the Western Capital, passed through Gong County, and paid respects at Anling with offerings.

sentences.zh: 雍熙二年，宗正少卿趙安易言：「昨朝拜安陵、永昌陵，有司止設酒、脯、香，以未明行事，不設燭燎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Zhao Anyi said: "Yesterday in paying court at Anling and Yongchang Mausoleum, the relevant offices only set out wine, dried meat, and incense; the rite was performed before dawn without setting lamps.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi Zhao Anyi, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan, reported: "Yesterday in paying court at Anling and Yongchang Mausoleum, the relevant offices only set out wine, dried meat, and incense; the rite was performed before dawn without lamps.

sentences.zh: 又先赴永昌陵，後赴安陵，及帝后二位不遍拜，頗愆於禮。」

translations.literal: Moreover, they first went to Yongchang Mausoleum and afterward to Anling, and did not pay full respects to both the emperor and empress, which greatly deviates from ritual."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover they first went to Yongchang Mausoleum and afterward to Anling, and did not pay full respects to both the emperor and empress, which greatly deviates from ritual.

sentences.zh: 事下有司，議曰：「按《開元禮》，春秋二仲月，司徒、司空巡陵，不設牲牢之祀。

translations.literal: The matter was transmitted to the relevant offices, which deliberated: "According to the Kaiyuan Rites, in the two mid-months of spring and autumn the Minister of Education and Minister of Works inspect the tombs, without setting out sacrificial victims.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was transmitted to the relevant offices, which deliberated: "According to the Kaiyuan Rites, in the two mid-months of spring and autumn the Minister of Education and Minister of Works inspect the tombs without setting out sacrificial victims.

sentences.zh: 今請如宗廟薦享，少加裁減，除不設登鉶、牙盤食及太常登歌外，餘悉如大祠。

translations.literal: Now we ask that it follow the ancestral temple seasonal offering, with slight reduction: except for not setting out the deng and zhu vessels, tooth-tray foods, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices ascending song, all else should follow the great sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: We now ask that it follow the ancestral temple seasonal offering with slight reduction: except for omitting the deng and zhu vessels, tooth-tray foods, and Court of Imperial Sacrifices ascending song, all else should follow the great sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 朝拜日，有司豫于陵南百步道東設次，具翦除器以備酒掃。

translations.literal: On the day of paying court, the relevant offices should beforehand set up a tent one hundred paces south of the tomb on the east side of the path, with trimming implements prepared for wine and sweeping.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of paying court the relevant offices should beforehand set up a tent one hundred paces south of the tomb on the east side of the path, with trimming implements prepared for wine and sweeping.

sentences.zh: 設宗正卿位於兆外之左，西向；

translations.literal: Set the Director of the Imperial Clan's position outside the tomb precinct to the left, facing west;
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan's position was to be set outside the tomb precinct to the left, facing west;

sentences.zh: 陵官位於卿之東南，執事官又于其南，俱西向北上。

translations.literal: the tomb official's position southeast of the director; officiating officials again south of that—all facing west with north to the right.
translations.idiomatic: the tomb official's position southeast of the director, and officiating officials again south of that—all facing west with north to the right.

sentences.zh: 設祭器、禮料、酒饌於兆門內。

translations.literal: Set sacrificial vessels, ritual supplies, and wine and food inside the tomb gate.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels, ritual supplies, and wine and food were to be set inside the tomb gate.

sentences.zh: 宗正卿以下各就位，再拜，盥手，奠酒，讀祝冊，再拜。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Clan and those below each took position, bowed twice, washed hands, presented wine, read the invocation book, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Imperial Clan and those below each took position, bowed twice, washed their hands, presented wine, read the invocation book, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 先赴安陵，次永昌陵，次孝明、孝惠、懿德、淑德皇后陵。」

translations.literal: First proceed to Anling, next Yongchang Mausoleum, next the mausoleums of Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, Yide, and Shude."
translations.idiomatic: They were to proceed first to Anling, next to Yongchang Mausoleum, and next to the mausoleums of Empresses Xiaoming, Xiaohui, Yide, and Shude.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 景德三年，真宗將朝諸陵，以宰臣王旦為朝拜諸陵大禮使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingde, Zhenzong was about to pay court at the various mausoleums; Chief Councillor Wang Dan was appointed Grand Ritual Commissioner for paying court at the various mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jingde Zhenzong was about to pay court at the various mausoleums; Chief Councillor Wang Dan was appointed Grand Ritual Commissioner for paying court at the various mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院言：「朝陵故事，合排小駕鹵簿。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices Directorate of Rites reported: "By precedent for paying court at the tombs, the small imperial escort guard of honor should be arranged.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices Directorate of Rites reported: "By precedent for paying court at the tombs, the small imperial escort guard of honor should be arranged.

sentences.zh: 唐太宗朝獻陵，宿設黃麾仗，周衛陵寢。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong of Tang paid court at Xian Mausoleum, the yellow banner guard was stationed overnight to encircle and guard the tomb precinct.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong of Tang paid court at Xian Mausoleum, the yellow banner guard was stationed overnight to encircle and guard the tomb precinct.

sentences.zh: 今請周設黃麾仗。

translations.literal: Now we request that the yellow banner guard be stationed to encircle the tomb precinct.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that the yellow banner guard be posted overnight to encircle and guard the mausoleum precinct.

sentences.zh: 又唐制：前一日，陵令以玉冊進禦親書，近臣奉出，陵令受之。

translations.literal: Also under Tang regulations: on the day before, the tomb director presents the jade book bearing the Emperor's own hand, a close minister carries it out, and the tomb director receives it.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang regulations as well, on the day before the rite the tomb director would present the jade book inscribed in the Emperor's own hand; a close minister would carry it out, and the tomb director would receive it.

sentences.zh: 今請造竹冊四副，祝畢焚之。

translations.literal: Now we request that four sets of bamboo books be made; after the invocation is read, they are to be burned.
translations.idiomatic: We now request that four sets of bamboo invocation books be prepared and burned after the invocation is read.

sentences.zh: 其百官位舊設陵所，從祝官及皇親、客使分於神道左右，貞觀中並陪列司馬門內。

translations.literal: The positions of the hundred officials were formerly set at the mausoleum precinct; accompanying invocation officials, imperial kinsmen, and foreign envoys were arrayed left and right along the spirit path—in the Zhenguan era all also stood in attendance inside the Sima Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The positions for the hundred officials were traditionally established at the mausoleum site; invocation attendants, imperial kinsmen, and foreign envoys were placed to left and right along the spirit path—in the Zhenguan era they all stood in attendance inside the Sima Gate as well.

sentences.zh: 今望准舊儀施行。

translations.literal: We now hope that the old rites may be approved and implemented.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the old rites be approved and put into practice.

sentences.zh: 又舊儀，詣寢宮至大次之時，設百官位，奏請行禮。

translations.literal: Also by old rite, when proceeding to the chamber hall up to the time at the grand temporary pavilion, the positions of the hundred officials are set and a request is submitted to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: By the old rite as well, when proceeding to the chamber hall and on arrival at the grand temporary pavilion, the positions of the hundred officials were set and formal request was made to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 望令先入赴寢殿立班。

translations.literal: We hope they may be ordered to enter first and take formation at the chamber hall.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that they be ordered to enter first and form ranks at the chamber hall.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，皇帝至小次，素服乘馬。

translations.literal: In the Zhenguan era, when the Emperor reached the minor temporary pavilion, he wore unadorned dress and rode a horse.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan era the Emperor, upon reaching the minor temporary pavilion, wore plain mourning dress and rode on horseback.

sentences.zh: 檢會今年正月，車駕朝拜明德欑宮，止服素白衣。

translations.literal: Checking against this year in the first month, when the imperial procession paid court at Empress Mingde's temporary burial pavilion, only plain white garments were worn.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing the precedent of this year's first month, when the imperial procession paid court at Empress Mingde's temporary burial pavilion, the Emperor wore only plain white robes.

sentences.zh: 當時皇帝在大祥之內，今既服除，望止服淡黃袍。

translations.literal: At that time the Emperor was within the extended mourning period; now that mourning has ended, we hope he will wear only a light yellow robe.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Emperor was still within the period of extended mourning; now that mourning has ended, we ask that he wear only a pale yellow robe.

sentences.zh: 又按貞觀、永徽故事，朝陵皆先親後尊，拜辭訖，出還大次，便進發，今望先朝永熙陵；

translations.literal: Also checking Zhenguan and Yonghui precedents, paying court at the tombs always placed the close relative first and the honored one after; when bowing and taking leave was finished, one went out and returned to the grand temporary pavilion and then set out—we now hope to pay court first at Yongxi Mausoleum;
translations.idiomatic: Checking Zhenguan and Yonghui precedents as well, tomb visits always placed the close relative before the more honored one; after bowing and taking leave one withdrew to the grand temporary pavilion and then set out—we now ask to visit Yongxi Mausoleum first;

sentences.zh: 行事及辭，皇帝皆兩次再拜，陪位官每陵亦各兩次再拜，今請皇帝詣安陵參辭，四度再拜，永昌、永熙陵各兩度設拜。

translations.literal: In performing the rites and in taking leave, the Emperor bowed twice on two occasions each, and attending officials at each mausoleum also each bowed twice on two occasions; we now request that when the Emperor proceeds to Anling to pay respects and take leave, he perform four double bows, and at Yongchang and Yongxi mausoleums perform two sets of bows each.
translations.idiomatic: For the rites themselves and for leave-taking, the Emperor performed two rounds of double bows, and attending officials at each mausoleum did likewise; we now request that at Anling the Emperor pay respects and take leave with four double bows, and at Yongchang and Yongxi Mausoleums two sets of bows each.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，逐寢殿上食，備太牢之饌，珍羞庶品。

translations.literal: By old rite, food was offered at each chamber hall, with a feast of the grand sacrificial set and rare delicacies of every sort.
translations.idiomatic: The old rite called for food offerings at each chamber hall with a full grand sacrificial feast and delicacies of every kind.

sentences.zh: 近以羊豕代太牢。

translations.literal: Recently sheep and pigs replaced the grand sacrificial set.
translations.idiomatic: Recently sheep and pigs had been substituted for the full grand sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 今請備少牢之祭，設奠、讀冊畢，復詣寢宮上珍羞庶品，別行致奠之禮。

translations.literal: We now request preparing the lesser sacrificial set; when the offerings are set and the book read is finished, one again proceeds to the chamber hall to offer rare delicacies of every sort, performing a separate rite of presentation.
translations.idiomatic: We now request the lesser sacrificial set; once the initial offering is set and the invocation read, the Emperor should again proceed to the chamber hall to present rare delicacies, in a separate rite of offering.

sentences.zh: 又舊儀，前發二日，太尉告太廟。

translations.literal: Also by old rite, two days before setting out, the Grand Commander announced at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The old rite also required that two days before departure the Grand Commander announce the visit at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 今請依禮遍告六室。」

translations.literal: We now request that, in accordance with ritual, announcement be made at all six chambers."
translations.idiomatic: We now ask that announcement be made at all six chambers in accordance with ritual.

sentences.zh: 詔特服素白衣，行事次序如告太廟，餘依所請。

translations.literal: An edict specially ordered plain white garments; the order of proceedings was as for announcement at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the remainder was as requested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that plain white garments be worn especially for the occasion, that the order of proceedings follow that for announcement at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and that the remainder of the requests be granted.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，車駕次鞏縣，罷鳴鞭及太常奏嚴、金吾傳呼。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year, when the imperial procession halted at Gong County, the whip-cracking and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices playing of the guard formation and the Golden Guard's relayed proclamation were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, when the imperial procession halted at Gong County, whip-cracking and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices guard formation and Golden Guard relayed proclamation were all suspended.

sentences.zh: 既至，齋于永安鎮行宮，太官進蔬膳。

translations.literal: Upon arrival, he fasted at the Yong'an Town traveling palace; the Directorate of Palace Receptions presented vegetarian fare.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival the Emperor fasted at the traveling palace at Yong'an Town, and the Directorate of Palace Receptions provided vegetarian meals.

sentences.zh: 是夜，漏未盡三鼓，帝乘馬，卻輿輦傘扇，至安陵，素服步入司馬門行奠獻禮，諸陵亦然。

translations.literal: That night, before the third watch had passed, the Emperor mounted a horse, leaving behind carriages, palanquin, umbrellas, and fans; he reached Anling, wore plain dress, and on foot entered the Sima Gate to perform the rites of offering and presentation—the other mausoleums were the same.
translations.idiomatic: That night, before the third watch had ended, the Emperor mounted a horse and set aside his carriage, palanquin, umbrellas, and fan bearers; at Anling he wore plain mourning dress and on foot entered the Sima Gate to perform the offering rites—the same at every mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 又詣下宮。

translations.literal: He also proceeded to the lower shrine.
translations.idiomatic: He also visited the lower shrine.

sentences.zh: 凡上宮用牲牢、祝冊，有司奉事；

translations.literal: Generally, at the upper shrine sacrificial livestock and invocation books were used, with the relevant offices conducting the rites;
translations.idiomatic: At the upper shrine in general, sacrificial livestock and invocation books were used and the relevant offices conducted the rites;

sentences.zh: 下宮備膳羞，內臣執事，百官陪位，又詣元德太后陵奠獻，別於陵西南設幄殿，祭如下宮。

translations.literal: At the lower shrine food offerings were prepared, inner-palace attendants performed the duties, the hundred officials stood in attendance, and he also proceeded to Empress Dowager Yuande's mausoleum to offer and present; separately at the southwest of the mausoleum a tent hall was set up, and the sacrifice was as at the lower shrine.
translations.idiomatic: At the lower shrine offerings were prepared, inner-palace attendants performed the duties, and the hundred officials stood in attendance; he also proceeded to Empress Dowager Yuande's mausoleum to offer sacrifice, and a tent hall was separately erected southwest of the tomb, with rites like those at the lower shrine.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，遍詣孝明、孝章、懿德、淑德、明德、莊懷七後陵，遂單騎從內臣巡視陵闕，而親奠夔、魏、岐、鄆、安、週六王及恭孝太子諸墳。

translations.literal: When the rites were finished, he proceeded in turn to the mausoleums of the seven late empresses Xiaoming, Xiaozhang, Yide, Shude, Mingde, and Zhuanghuai; then he rode alone with inner attendants to inspect the mausoleum precincts, and personally offered at the tombs of the six princes of Kui, Wei, Qi, Yun, An, and Zhou and the Crown Prince Gongxiao and other tombs.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete he visited in turn the mausoleums of the seven late empresses Xiaoming, Xiaozhang, Yide, Shude, Mingde, and Zhuanghuai; then, riding alone with inner attendants, he inspected the mausoleum gates and personally made offerings at the tombs of Princes Kui, Wei, Qi, Yun, An, and Zhou, Crown Prince Gongxiao, and others.

sentences.zh: 其三陵陪葬皇子、皇孫、公主之未出閣者，及諸王夫人之蚤亡者，各設位次諸陵下宮之東序。

translations.literal: At the three mausoleums, buried accompanying princes, imperial grandsons, and princesses who had not yet left the palace, and wives of various princes who had died early, each had positions set east of the lower shrine at the various mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: At the three mausoleums, for accompanying buried princes, imperial grandsons, and princesses who had not yet come of age, and for early-deceased wives of princes, separate positions were set east of each mausoleum's lower shrine.

sentences.zh: 安陵百二十一墳，量設三十位，男子、女子共祝版二；

translations.literal: Anling had 121 tombs; positions were allotted for thirty; men and women together shared two invocation boards;
translations.idiomatic: Anling had 121 attendant tombs, for which thirty positions were allotted, with two invocation boards shared between men and women;

sentences.zh: 昌陵十五墳，量設十位，熙陵八墳，量設五位，並祝版一以致祭焉。

translations.literal: Yongchang Mausoleum had fifteen tombs; positions were allotted for ten; Yongxi Mausoleum had eight tombs; positions were allotted for five—all with one invocation board each to perform the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang Mausoleum had fifteen tombs with ten positions allotted; Yongxi Mausoleum had eight tombs with five positions allotted—each group using a single invocation board for the offerings.

sentences.zh: 辰後，暫詣幄次更衣，復詣諸陵奉辭。

translations.literal: After the chen watch, he briefly proceeded to the tent pavilion to change dress, then again proceeded to the various mausoleums to take leave.
translations.idiomatic: After the chen watch he briefly withdrew to the tent pavilion to change clothes, then returned to each mausoleum to take leave.

sentences.zh: 有司以朝拜無辭禮，帝不忍，故復往。

translations.literal: The relevant offices held that paying court at the tombs had no rite of leave-taking; the Emperor could not bear it, and so went again.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices held that tomb visits had no formal leave-taking rite, but the Emperor could not bear to omit it and returned again.

sentences.zh: 仍遣官祭一品皇親諸親墓。

translations.literal: He still dispatched officials to sacrifice at tombs of first-rank imperial kinsmen and other kinsmen.
translations.idiomatic: He also dispatched officials to offer sacrifice at the tombs of first-rank imperial kinsmen and other imperial relatives.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符四年正月，祀汾陰，經鞏縣，有司請于訾村王台設幄殿，置三陵神坐，皇帝靴袍就幄，設香酒、時果、牙盤食奠獻，而命大臣以香幣、酒脯詣諸陵致告。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when sacrificing at Fenyin, passing through Gong County, the relevant offices requested setting up a tent hall at Zicun Wang Terrace, placing spirit seats for the three mausoleums; the Emperor in boots and robe approached the tent, setting incense, wine, seasonal fruits, and tray foods to offer and present, while ordering great ministers with incense, silks, wine, and dried meat to proceed to the various mausoleums to announce.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, on the Fenyin sacrifice and passing through Gong County, the relevant offices asked that a tent hall be erected at Zicun Wang Terrace with spirit seats for the three mausoleums; the Emperor, in formal boots and robe, approached the tent with incense, wine, seasonal fruit, and tray foods for offering, while great ministers were dispatched with incense, silks, wine, and dried meat to announce the visit at each mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 駕還，復行親謁之禮，帝素服乘馬至永安縣，齋於行宮，夜漏未盡二鼓，詣三陵及元德太后、明德皇后陵奠獻，哀慟。

translations.literal: When the imperial procession returned, the rite of personal audience was again performed; the Emperor in plain dress rode a horse to Yong'an County, fasted at the traveling palace; before the second watch had passed at night he proceeded to the three mausoleums and the mausoleums of Empress Dowager Yuande and Empress Mingde to offer and present, deeply grief-stricken.
translations.idiomatic: On the return journey the personal visit rite was performed again; the Emperor wore plain dress and rode to Yong'an County, fasting at the traveling palace; before the second watch ended he proceeded to the three mausoleums and to Empress Dowager Yuande's and Empress Mingde's mausoleums to offer sacrifice, overcome with grief.

sentences.zh: 未明，禮畢，復詣四陵奉辭，省視几筵，奠獻如初禮。

translations.literal: Before dawn the rites were finished; again proceeding to the four mausoleums to take leave, inspecting the spirit tables, offerings and presentation as in the initial rite.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn the rites were complete; he again visited four mausoleums to take leave, inspected the spirit tables, and presented offerings as in the initial rite.

sentences.zh: 又遍詣諸後陵、諸王墳致奠。

translations.literal: He also proceeded in turn to the various late empresses' mausoleums and princes' tombs to present offerings.
translations.idiomatic: He also visited in turn the mausoleums of the various late empresses and princes' tombs to present offerings.

sentences.zh: 命中使遍祭皇親諸親墳及汝州秦王墳。

translations.literal: He ordered emissaries to proceed in turn to sacrifice at tombs of imperial kinsmen, other kinsmen, and the tomb of the Prince of Qin at Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered palace emissaries to sacrifice in turn at the tombs of imperial kinsmen and other relatives, and at the Prince of Qin's tomb in Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 是歲，命禮官定春秋二仲遣官朝陵儀注，以祭服行事，專差宗正卿一員朝拜三陵，別遣官二員分拜諸陵。

translations.literal: That year, ritual officials were ordered to fix the protocol for dispatching officials to pay court at the tombs in the second and eighth months of spring and autumn; they were to conduct the rites in sacrificial dress, specifically assigning one Director of the Imperial Clan to pay court at the three mausoleums, and separately dispatching two officials to pay court separately at the various mausoleums.
translations.idiomatic: That year ritual officials were ordered to establish the protocol for dispatching officials to pay court at the tombs at the spring and autumn equinoxes; they were to wear sacrificial dress, with one Director of the Imperial Clan assigned to the three mausoleums and two other officials dispatched to the remaining mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 又制長竿簷床二副，置陵表祝版，遣寬衣軍士三十二人輿送陵下。

translations.literal: Also two sets of long-pole eave beds were made, placing tomb-table invocation boards; thirty-two soldiers in everyday dress were dispatched to carry them by litter to the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Two sets of long-pole canopied litters were also made to carry the tomb-table invocation boards, and thirty-two soldiers in everyday dress were sent to convey them to the mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 其後添差陵廟行禮官四員，選朝官、京官宗姓者充。

translations.literal: Thereafter four additional officials performing rites at the mausoleum temples were added, selected from court officials, capital officials of the imperial surname.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter four additional officials to perform rites at the mausoleum temples were added, chosen from court and capital officials of imperial clansmen.

sentences.zh: 翰林學士錢惟演言：「春秋朝陵，載於舊式，公卿親往，蓋表至恭。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician Qian Weiyan said: "Paying court at the tombs in spring and autumn is recorded in the old regulations; dukes and ministers went in person—this showed the utmost reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin Academician Qian Weiyan said: "Spring and autumn tomb visits are recorded in the old regulations, and dukes and ministers went in person—that was the utmost reverence.

sentences.zh: 唐顯慶中，始詔三公行事，天寶以後，亦遣公卿巡謁，蓋取朝廷大臣，不必須同國姓。

translations.literal: In the Xianqing era of Tang, an edict first ordered the Three Excellencies to perform the rites; after Tianbao as well, dukes and ministers were also dispatched on circuit visits—they took senior court ministers without requiring the same imperial surname.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang's Xianqing era an edict first ordered the Three Excellencies to perform the rites; after Tianbao as well, dukes and ministers were dispatched on inspection visits—the idea was to send senior court ministers regardless of imperial surname.

sentences.zh: 後參用太常、宗正卿。

translations.literal: Later the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director and Director of the Imperial Clan were used jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director and Director of the Imperial Clan were used together.

sentences.zh: 晉開運中，亦命吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyun era of Jin as well, a Vice Minister of Personnel was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In Jin's Kaiyun era a Vice Minister of Personnel was also appointed.

sentences.zh: 近年以來，止遣宗正寺官，人輕位卑，實虧舊制，望自今于丞、郎、諸司三品內遣官，闕則差兩省諫、舍以上。

translations.literal: In recent years only officials of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan have been dispatched—the men are light and the position low, truly falling short of the old system; we hope that from now officials may be dispatched from among vice directors, court gentlemen, and third-rank officials of the various bureaus; where lacking, remonstrance and drafting officials of the two secretariats and above.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years only officials of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan have been sent—men of little weight in positions too low, falling short of the old system. We ask that from now on officials be chosen from vice directors, court gentlemen, and third-rank bureau officials, or if none are available from remonstrance and drafting officials of the two secretariats and above.

sentences.zh: 所冀仰副追孝之心，以成稽古之美。」

translations.literal: What is hoped is to match the heart of filial remembrance on high and to complete the beauty of examining antiquity."
translations.idiomatic: This would satisfy the spirit of filial remembrance and fulfill the ideal of honoring ancient precedent."

sentences.zh: 景祐初，滄州觀察使守節言：「寒食節例遣宗室拜陵，而十月令內司賓往，非所以致恭。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingyou, Cangzhou Observation Commissioner Shoujie said: "By Cold Food Festival precedent imperial clansmen were dispatched to pay court at the tombs, but in the tenth month the Inner Palace Protocol Officer was sent—this is not how reverence is shown."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jingyou, Cangzhou Observation Commissioner Shoujie said: "Cold Food Festival custom sends imperial clansmen to pay court at the tombs, but in the tenth month the Inner Palace Protocol Officer is sent—that does not show proper reverence.

sentences.zh: 乃詔宗室正刺史以上一員朝拜。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered that one imperial clansman of regular prefect rank or above pay court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was then issued ordering one imperial clansman of regular prefect rank or above to perform the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 四年，減柏子戶，安陵、永昌、永熙各留四十戶，永定五十戶，會聖宮十戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, cypress-guard households were reduced; Anling, Yongchang, and Yongxi each retained forty households; Yongding fifty households; Huisheng Palace ten households.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the cypress-guard households were reduced: Anling, Yongchang, and Yongxi each retained forty households, Yongding fifty, and Huisheng Palace ten.

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年寒食、十月朔，宗室刺史以上，聽更往朝陵。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingli, on Cold Food Festival and on the first of the tenth month, imperial clansmen of prefect rank or above were permitted to visit the tombs again in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 2, on Cold Food Festival and the first day of the tenth month, imperial clansmen of prefect rank or above were permitted to visit the tombs again in rotation.

sentences.zh: 皇祐三年，太常博士李壽朋奏：「帝后諸陵，薦饗皆有時，獨昭憲皇后以合葬安陵，不及時祭。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Huangyou, Libationer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Shoupeng memorialized: "The sacrificial offerings for the tombs of emperors and empresses all have their seasons; only Empress Zhaoxian, being buried jointly at Anling, has no timely sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: In Huangyou 3, Court of Imperial Sacrifices Libationer Li Shoupeng memorialized: "Offerings at the tombs of emperors and empresses are all on fixed schedules, but Empress Zhaoxian, buried jointly at Anling, has no timely sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 禮院言：「朝拜儀注，牲牢並如太廟常饗例，諸陵止奠一爵，而安陵奠兩爵，兩贊再拜，惟祭饌不兼設，蓋有司相承失之。」

translations.literal: The Ritual Academy said: "In the protocol for paying court, sacrificial livestock follows the regular offering precedent of the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the various mausoleums present only one cup, but Anling presents two cups, with two acclamations and double bows; only the sacrificial foods are not set together—this is an error handed down by the relevant offices."
translations.idiomatic: The Ritual Academy replied: "In the tomb-visit protocol, sacrificial livestock should follow the Imperial Ancestral Temple's regular offering, and other mausoleums present only one libation cup whereas Anling presents two, with two acclamations and double bows—but sacrificial foods are not set jointly, an error perpetuated by the relevant offices.

sentences.zh: 於是詔安陵昭憲皇后祝版、牲幣、禦封香依太廟同室禮。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered that at Anling Empress Zhaoxian's invocation board, sacrificial silks, and imperial sealed incense follow the rite for shared chambers in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered that at Anling the invocation board, sacrificial silks, and imperial sealed incense for Empress Zhaoxian follow the shared-chamber rite of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 更造諸陵祭器貯別庫。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels for the various mausoleums were newly made and stored in a separate depot.
translations.idiomatic: New sacrificial vessels for the various mausoleums were made and stored in a separate depot.

sentences.zh: 三陵皆置卒五百人，唯定陵以章獻太后故，別置一指揮。

translations.literal: At all three mausoleums five hundred soldiers were stationed; only at Dingling, because of Empress Dowager Zhangxian, a separate command was additionally stationed.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred soldiers were posted at each of the three mausoleums; at Dingling alone, because of Empress Dowager Zhangxian, an additional separate command was posted.

sentences.zh: 昭陵使甘昭吉引定陵例，請置守陵奉先兩指揮，京西轉運司請減定陵卒半以奉昭陵，詔選募一指揮，額五百人。

translations.literal: Zhaoling Commissioner Gan Zhaoji citing the Dingling precedent requested establishing two commands for guarding the tomb and honoring the ancestors; the Western Capital Transport Commission requested halving Dingling's soldiers to supply Zhaoling; an edict ordered selecting and recruiting one command, quota five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoling Commissioner Gan Zhaoji, citing the Dingling precedent, asked that two commands be established for tomb-guard and ancestral veneration; the Western Capital Transport Commission proposed halving Dingling's garrison to supply Zhaoling; an edict ordered recruiting one command with a quota of five hundred men.

sentences.zh: 初，永安縣官月朔朝定陵，望朝三陵。

translations.literal: Initially, Yong'an County officials paid court at Dingling on the first of the month and at the three mausoleums on the fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Yong'an County officials paid court at Dingling on the first of the month and at the three mausoleums on the fifteenth.

sentences.zh: 韓琦言：「昭陵未有朝日。」

translations.literal: Han Qi said: "Zhaoling has no regular day of court."
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi said: "Zhaoling has no fixed day for monthly worship.

sentences.zh: 乃令縣官朔望分朝諸陵。

translations.literal: Thereupon county officials were ordered to divide visits among the various mausoleums on the first and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: County officials were then ordered to divide first- and fifteenth-day visits among the various mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 熙甯中，詔文臣大兩省、武臣閣門使以上，經過陵下，並許朝拜。

translations.literal: In the Xining era, an edict ordered that civil officials of the two great secretariats and military officials of Palace Gate commissioner or above, when passing below the mausoleums, were all permitted to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era an edict permitted civil officials of the two great secretariats and military officials of Palace Gate commissioner or above to pay court when passing any mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 又詔：「自今臣僚朝拜諸陵，除見任、嘗任執政官許進湯，餘止奠獻、薦新，不特拜。」

translations.literal: Also an edict: "From now when officials pay court at the various mausoleums, except incumbent and former chief councillors who are permitted to be served tea, the rest shall only present offerings and seasonal offerings, without special bows."
translations.idiomatic: Another edict stated: "From now when officials visit the mausoleums, only incumbent and former chief councillors may be served tea; all others shall present offerings and seasonal offerings only, without special bows."

sentences.zh: 初，故事，車駕詣陵，謂之親謁。

translations.literal: Initially, by precedent when the imperial procession proceeded to a mausoleum it was called a personal audience.
translations.idiomatic: By old precedent, an imperial visit to the tombs was called a personal audience.

sentences.zh: 南渡之後，此禮不舉，故上陵或曰省視，或曰保護，或曰薦獻，或曰祭告，或曰致祭，或曰望祭，或曰修奉，悉遣官，不專於行禮也。

translations.literal: After the southward migration this rite was no longer performed, so visiting the tombs might be called inspection, protection, offering and presentation, announcement and sacrifice, performing sacrifice, distant sacrifice, or maintenance—all by dispatched officials, not devoted solely to performing rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the court moved south this rite was no longer performed, so tomb visits might be styled inspection, protection, offering, announcement, sacrifice, distant offering, or maintenance—all carried out by dispatched officials rather than as dedicated ritual visits.

sentences.zh: 建炎元年五月一日詔：「應永安軍祖宗陵寢，可差西京留守及台臣一員躬親省視，如有合修奉去處，措置奏聞。」

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month in the first year of Jianyan, an edict: "For the imperial tombs of the ancestors at Yong'an Prefecture, the Western Capital Military Governor and one Censorial official may be dispatched to inspect in person; where maintenance is needed, arrangements are to be reported."
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month of Jianyan 1 an edict ordered: "At the ancestral tombs in Yong'an Prefecture, the Western Capital Military Governor and one censorial official should inspect in person and report on any repairs needed.

sentences.zh: 仍詔鄜延路副總管劉光世充省視陵寢使。

translations.literal: Still an edict appointed Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Zhenyan Circuit Liu Guangshi as Commissioner for Inspecting the Imperial Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guangshi, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Zhenyan Circuit, was also appointed Commissioner for Inspecting the Imperial Tombs.

sentences.zh: 又詔河南府鎮撫使翟興團結本處義兵，保護祖宗陵寢。

translations.literal: Also an edict ordered Henan Prefecture Pacification Commissioner Zhai Xing to organize local righteous militia in the area to protect the ancestral tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Xing, Henan Prefecture Pacification Commissioner, was also ordered to organize local militia to protect the ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，詔令禮部給降度牒一百道充祭告諸陵禮料，仍令翟興所差來人賚祭告表以行。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites to issue one hundred ordination certificates to supply ritual materials for announcing and sacrificing at the various tombs, and still ordered men dispatched by Zhai Xing to carry the announcement and sacrifice memorials on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year the Ministry of Rites was ordered to issue one hundred ordination certificates as ritual supplies for tomb announcements and sacrifices, and men dispatched by Zhai Xing were to carry the announcement and sacrifice memorials.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，上謂輔臣曰：「祖宗陵寢，久淪異域，今金國既割還故地，便當遣宗室使相與臣僚前去修奉灑掃。」

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, the Emperor said to chief ministers: "The ancestral tombs have long lain in foreign territory; now that the Jin state has ceded back the old lands, imperial clansmen of ministerial rank and officials should be sent at once to maintain and sweep them."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year the Emperor told his chief ministers: "Our ancestral tombs have long lain in enemy territory; now that the Jin have restored the old lands, we should send imperial clansmen of ministerial rank and officials to restore and sweep them.

sentences.zh: 尋命同判大宗正事士亻褭、兵部侍郎張燾前雲河南府祗謁修奉。

translations.literal: Soon Vice Director of the Imperial Clan Shìniǎn and Vice Minister of War Zhang Tao were ordered to proceed to Henan Prefecture to pay reverent court and maintain the tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Shìniǎn, Vice Director of the Imperial Clan, and Zhang Tao, Vice Minister of War, were soon ordered to Henan Prefecture to pay reverent court and restore the tombs.

sentences.zh: 六月，太常丞梁仲敏等言：「春秋二仲，遣宗室遙郡防禦使薦獻諸陵，太常少卿薦獻永祐陵，權宜於行在設位行禮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Libationer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liang Zhongmin and others said: "In the second and eighth months of spring and autumn, imperial clansmen as Defender-in-Chief of a Remote Prefecture are dispatched to offer at the various tombs, and the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to offer at Yongyou Mausoleum—a temporary measure of setting up positions at the mobile court to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Liang Zhongmin, Libationer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and others reported: "At the spring and autumn equinoxes, remote prefecture defenders from the imperial clan offer at the various tombs, and the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices at Yongyou Mausoleum—a temporary arrangement using positions set up at the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 今道路既通，望依舊遣官前詣。」

translations.literal: Now that the roads are open, we hope that officials may be dispatched as of old to proceed there."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the roads are open we ask that officials again be sent there as before.

sentences.zh: 詔令西京留守司候仲秋就便選官前詣諸陵薦獻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Western Capital Military Governor to select officials when convenient at the mid-autumn festival to proceed to the various tombs to offer.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Western Capital Military Governor to select officials at mid-autumn when convenient and send them to the various tombs to offer.

sentences.zh: 士亻褭、張燾回，言：「諸陵下石澗水，自兵興以來，涸竭幾十五年。

translations.literal: Shìniǎn and Zhang Tao returned and said: "The stone-brook water below the various tombs, since the rise of warfare, has been dry for nearly fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: When Shìniǎn and Zhang Tao returned they reported: "The stone-brook water below the various tombs had been dry for nearly fifteen years since the wars began.

sentences.zh: 二使到日，水即大至，父老驚歎，以為中興之祥。」

translations.literal: On the day the two envoys arrived, the water suddenly rose greatly; the elders marveled, taking it as an omen of restoration."
translations.idiomatic: On the day the two envoys arrived the water surged; local elders were astonished, taking it as a sign of the dynasty's restoration."

sentences.zh: 十年三月，禮部言：「池州銅陵縣丞呂和問進宮陵儀制，望付太常寺以備檢照。

translations.literal: In the third month of the tenth year, the Ministry of Rites said: "Tongling County Assistant Magistrate of Chizhou Lü Hewen submitted protocols for imperial tomb rites; we hope they may be given to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices for reference.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, third month, the Ministry of Rites reported: "Lü Hewen, assistant magistrate of Tongling County in Chizhou, submitted protocols for imperial tomb rites; we ask that they be forwarded to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices for reference.

sentences.zh: 永安軍等處今已收復，遂委知軍詣諸陵逐位檢視，除永定、永昭、永厚、永裕、永泰陵園廟並無損動，內永安、永昌、永熙陵神台璺裂，未敢一面擅行補飾。

translations.literal: Yong'an Prefecture and other places have now been recovered; the military prefect was therefore ordered to proceed to the various tombs to inspect each in turn; except Yongding, Yongzhao, Yonghou, Yongyu, and Yongtai garden temples and mausoleums, all were untouched; within these, the spirit platforms of Yong'an, Yongchang, and Yongxi mausoleums were cracked; they did not dare on their own authority to repair and adorn them all at once.
translations.idiomatic: Yong'an Prefecture and other sites having been recovered, the military prefect was ordered to inspect each mausoleum in turn; the garden temples and precincts of Yongding, Yongzhao, Yonghou, Yongyu, and Yongtai were undamaged, but the spirit platforms at Yong'an, Yongchang, and Yongxi mausoleums were cracked—they did not dare undertake repairs unilaterally.

sentences.zh: 太常寺看詳若行補修，合就差所委修飾官奏告行禮。」

translations.literal: If the Court of Imperial Sacrifices upon review decides repair should proceed, it would be appropriate to dispatch the officials assigned to adorn and report before performing the rites."
translations.idiomatic: If the Court of Imperial Sacrifices upon review approves repair, the officials assigned to restoration should report and perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 詔令河南府委官，如法補飾，不得滅裂。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Henan Prefecture to assign officials to repair and adorn according to regulations, without shoddy work.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Henan Prefecture to assign officials to repair in accordance with regulations, without negligent workmanship.

sentences.zh: 其後兵部侍郎兼史館修撰張燾言：「伏見宣諭官方庭實有請，乞將來先帝山陵，一依永安陵等制度。

translations.literal: Thereafter Vice Minister of War and concurrently Historiographic Compiler Zhang Tao said: "Your servant has seen in the imperial pronouncement that Fang Tingjie made a request, asking that future imperial mountain tombs follow the system of Yong'an Mausoleum and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhang Tao, Vice Minister of War and Historiographic Compiler, said: "In the imperial pronouncement I saw Fang Tingjie's request that future imperial tombs follow the Yong'an system.

sentences.zh: 臣區區愚忠，願明詔有司，異時永固陵凡金玉珍寶盡斥不用，播告天下，咸使聞知。

translations.literal: Your servant's petty loyal heart wishes a clear edict to the relevant offices: when in future the Ever-Firm Mausoleum is built, all gold, jade, and treasure entirely rejected and not used—proclaimed to all under Heaven, that all may hear and know.
translations.idiomatic: In my humble loyalty I ask that the throne issue a clear edict to the relevant offices: when the Ever-Firm Mausoleum is built, all gold, jade, and treasure shall be entirely forsworn, proclaimed throughout the realm so that all may know.

sentences.zh: 如是，自然可保無虞。」

translations.literal: If so, naturally it can be kept free from worry."
translations.idiomatic: Thus the tombs would naturally remain secure.

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and accepted this.

sentences.zh: 三十二年六月，詔祖宗陵寢，令本處招討使同本處官吏躬親朝謁，如法修奉，務在嚴潔，以稱孝思之意。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, an edict ordered the ancestral tombs: the local Pacification Commissioner together with local officials were to pay court and perform maintenance in person according to regulations, striving for strict cleanliness, to accord with the heart of filial remembrance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, sixth month, an edict ordered that at the ancestral mausoleums the local Pacification Commissioner and local officials pay court and maintain them in person according to regulation, with scrupulous cleanliness, in keeping with filial remembrance.

sentences.zh: 乾道六年八月，詔承信郎劉湛特轉兩官，右迪功郎劉師顏特與右承務郎升擢差遣，秦世輔特轉一官，升充正將，以湛等歸正結義保護陵寢故也。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year of Qiandao, an edict specially promoted Assurance Gentleman Liu Zhan two ranks, Aspirant Gentleman Liu Shiyan was specially granted Right Assurance Gentleman with promotion and assignment, Qin Shifu was specially promoted one rank and promoted to Senior Commander—for Zhan and others had returned to allegiance and sworn fellowship to protect the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 6, eighth month, Assurance Gentleman Liu Zhan was specially promoted two ranks; Aspirant Gentleman Liu Shiyan was specially granted Right Assurance Gentleman with promotion and assignment; Qin Shifu was specially promoted one rank to Senior Commander—for they had reaffirmed allegiance and sworn fellowship to protect the imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 端平元年正月，京西湖北安撫制置使史嵩之露布以滅金聞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Duanping, the Jingxi-Hubei Pacification Commissioner and Military Affairs Set-up Commissioner Shi Songzhi announced by sealed dispatch that the Jin had been destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Duanping 1, Shi Songzhi, Pacification Commissioner and Military Affairs Set-up Commissioner of Jingxi and Hubei, announced by sealed dispatch that the Jin had been destroyed.

sentences.zh: 二月，御筆：「國家南渡以後，八陵迥隔，常切痛心。

translations.literal: In the second month, imperial brush: "Since the state crossed south, the eight tombs have been far separated; one has constantly sliced the heart in pain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Emperor wrote in his own hand: "Since the court moved south, the eight tombs have lain far away—a constant wound to the heart.

sentences.zh: 今京湖帥臣以圖來上，恭覽再三，悲喜交集，凡在臣子，諒同此情。

translations.literal: Now the military commissioner of Jing and Hu has submitted a map; reverently perused again and again, joy and grief intermingled; all who are subjects surely share this feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Now the commander of Jing and Hu has submitted a map; reading it again and again, joy and grief mingled—every subject surely shares this feeling.

sentences.zh: 可令卿、監、郎官以上，詣尚書省恭眡集議。」

translations.literal: Court gentlemen, supervisors, and court officials and above may proceed to the Ministry of Personnel to reverently view and assemble for deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: Let court gentlemen, supervisors, and officials of third rank and above proceed to the Ministry of Personnel to view the map and convene for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 遂遣太常寺主簿朱揚祖、閣門祗候林拓朝謁八陵。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Registrar Zhu Yangzu and Palace Gate Attendant Lin Tuo were dispatched to pay court at the eight tombs.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices Registrar Zhu Yangzu and Palace Gate Attendant Lin Tuo were then dispatched to pay court at the eight tombs.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年六月，太常寺言：「昭慈獻烈皇太后欑宮在越州會稽縣，合依四孟朝獻禮例，差宰執一員，前一日赴欑宮泰寧寺宿齋，至日，行朝拜之禮。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Shaoxing, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "The temporary burial pavilion of Empress Dowager Zhaoci Xianlie is in Kuaiji County, Yuezhou; it should follow the precedent for offerings at the four seasonal first months, dispatching one chief councillor who on the day before proceeds to the temporary burial pavilion at Taining Temple to fast, and on the day performs the rite of paying court."
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 1, sixth month, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "Empress Dowager Zhaoci Xianlie's temporary burial pavilion is in Kuaiji County, Yuezhou; following the four seasonal first-month offering precedent, one chief councillor should fast at Taining Temple by the pavilion the day before and perform the court visit on the day.

sentences.zh: 詔同知樞密院事李回行禮。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Vice Director of the Privy Council Li Hui to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hui, Vice Director of the Privy Council, was ordered to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，知紹興府張守言：「昭慈獻烈皇后欑宮近在府界，望許臣以時朝謁。」

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, Prefect of Shaoxing Zhang Shou said: "The temporary burial pavilion of Empress Zhaoci Xianlie is near the prefectural boundary; we hope the subject may be permitted to pay court at the proper times."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, third month, Zhang Shou, Prefect of Shaoxing, said: "Empress Zhaoci Xianlie's temporary burial pavilion lies within the prefecture; I ask permission to pay court at the proper times.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 自是守臣皆許朝謁。

translations.literal: From this the prefects were all permitted to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter all prefects were permitted to pay court.

sentences.zh: 十七年十一月，殿中侍御史余堯弼言：「望舉行舊制，于春秋二仲遣官詣永祐陵欑宮薦獻。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventeenth year, Palace Censor Yu Yaobi said: "We hope the old system may be implemented, dispatching officials in the second and eighth months of spring and autumn to proceed to Yongyou Mausoleum's temporary burial pavilion to offer."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, eleventh month, Palace Censor Yu Yaobi said: "We ask that the old system be restored, dispatching officials at the spring and autumn equinoxes to Yongyou Mausoleum's temporary burial pavilion to offer.

sentences.zh: 臣僚又言：「陵廟之祭，月有薦新，著在令典。

translations.literal: Officials also said: "Sacrifice at mausoleum temples has monthly seasonal offerings recorded in the ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: Officials also said: "Mausoleum sacrifice includes monthly seasonal offerings recorded in the ordinances.

sentences.zh: 方今宗廟久已遵奉，惟是永祐陵闕而未講，望令有司討論，舉而行之。」

translations.literal: At present the Imperial Ancestral Temple has long been duly observed, but Yongyou Mausoleum alone has not been addressed; we hope the relevant offices may discuss and implement it."
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Ancestral Temple has long been duly served, but Yongyou Mausoleum alone has not; we ask the relevant offices to study and implement this.

sentences.zh: 太常寺討論：「欲依《政和五禮》依典故，令兩欑宮遵依每月檢舉，差官行禮，其新物令逐宮預行關報紹興府排辦。」

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated: "We wish to follow the Zhenghe Five Rites according to precedent, ordering the two temporary burial pavilions to observe monthly inspection, dispatch officials to perform rites, and have each pavilion in advance report to Shaoxing Prefecture to arrange the seasonal offerings."
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices deliberated: "We propose following the Zhenghe Five Rites and precedent: the two temporary burial pavilions should inspect monthly, dispatch officials to perform rites, and have each pavilion notify Shaoxing Prefecture in advance to arrange seasonal offerings.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十七年六月，詔：「永祐陵及昭慈聖獻皇后欑宮檢察承受，以檢察宮陵所為名。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year, an edict: "The inspection and reception for Yongyou Mausoleum and Empress Zhaoci Shengxian's temporary burial pavilion shall be called the Office for Supervising Imperial Tombs and Shrines."
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, sixth month, an edict established inspection and reception for Yongyou Mausoleum and Empress Zhaoci Shengxian's temporary burial pavilion under the name Office for Supervising Imperial Tombs and Shrines.

sentences.zh: 三十年九月，吏部言：「紹興府會稽知縣依仿陵台令典故，於階銜內帶兼主管欑宮事務，量加優異。」

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirtieth year, the Ministry of Personnel said: "The Kuaiji county magistrate of Shaoxing Prefecture, following the precedent of the Mausoleum Platform Director, in his title concurrently supervises affairs of the temporary burial pavilion, with appropriate added preferment."
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, ninth month, the Ministry of Personnel reported: "Shaoxing Prefecture's Kuaiji county magistrate, following the Mausoleum Platform Director precedent, should in his title concurrently supervise the temporary burial pavilions, with appropriate additional preferment."

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年正月，禮部、太常寺言：「春秋二仲，差太常少卿薦獻永祐陵欑宮，並周視陵域。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Chunxi, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "In the two mid-seasons of spring and autumn, dispatch the Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to offer seasonal sacrifices at the temporary burial pavilion of Yongyou Mausoleum, and jointly inspect the mausoleum precinct.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chunxi, first month, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "In the two mid-seasons of spring and autumn, a Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices should be dispatched to offer seasonal sacrifices at Yongyou Mausoleum's temporary burial pavilion and to inspect the entire mausoleum precinct.

sentences.zh: 如遇少卿有缺，乞從本寺前期取指揮。

translations.literal: If the vice directorship should be vacant, we request that orders be obtained in advance from this Court.
translations.idiomatic: If the vice directorship is vacant, we ask that orders be obtained from the Court in advance.

sentences.zh: 差本寺以次官充攝。

translations.literal: Dispatch the next official in rank within this Court to serve as acting substitute.
translations.idiomatic: An official next in rank within the Court should serve as acting substitute.

sentences.zh: 所有今年仲春薦獻，即日見闕少卿。」

translations.literal: The mid-spring seasonal offering of this year presently lacks a vice director."
translations.idiomatic: This year's mid-spring offering currently lacks a vice director.

sentences.zh: 詔差太常丞錢良臣。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Qian Liangchen.
translations.idiomatic: The court appointed Assistant Director Qian Liangchen of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 自後春秋遇少卿闕，率以為例。

translations.literal: Thereafter, whenever the vice directorship was vacant in spring or autumn, this was invariably taken as precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, whenever a spring or autumn offering found the vice directorship vacant, this became the established precedent.

sentences.zh: 慶元元年六月，詔：「永阜陵孝宗皇帝欑宮，每歲秋季一就，令所差監察御史恭詣朝拜檢察。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Qingyuan, an edict stated: "At Emperor Xiaozong's temporary burial pavilion at Yongfu Mausoleum, once each autumn year, the assigned investigating censor should respectfully proceed to pay court, worship, and inspect."
translations.idiomatic: In Qingyuan 1, sixth month, an edict ordered: "At Emperor Xiaozong's temporary burial pavilion at Yongfu Mausoleum, the assigned investigating censor should once each autumn respectfully pay court, worship, and inspect.

sentences.zh: 從御史台申請。

translations.literal: At the request of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: This followed a petition from the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 諸陵亦如之。

translations.literal: All other mausoleums followed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same arrangement applied to all other imperial mausoleums.

sentences.zh: 忌日，唐初始著罷樂、廢務及行香、修齋之文。

translations.literal: For memorial days, at the beginning of Tang regulations were first set down on ceasing music, suspending affairs, burning incense, and performing vegetarian rites.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations for memorial days first appeared under Tang, prescribing cessation of music, suspension of official business, incense offerings, and vegetarian observances.

sentences.zh: 基後，又朔望停朝，令天下上州皆准式行香。

translations.literal: After this foundation, on the first and fifteenth of each month court was also suspended, and all superior prefectures in the realm were ordered to burn incense according to formula.
translations.idiomatic: After these initial provisions, court sessions were also suspended on the first and fifteenth of each month, and all superior prefectures empire-wide were required to offer incense according to established procedure.

sentences.zh: 天祐初，始令百官詣閣奉慰。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou, officials were first ordered to proceed to the pavilion to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tianyou era, officials were first ordered to proceed to the pavilion to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 宋循其制，惟宣祖、昭憲皇后為大忌。

translations.literal: Song followed this system; only the Xuan Ancestor and Empress Zhaoxian were major memorial days.
translations.idiomatic: Song followed this system, but only the Xuan Ancestor and Empress Zhaoxian were observed as major memorial days.

sentences.zh: 前一日不坐，群臣詣西上閣門奉慰，移班奉慰皇太后，退，赴佛寺行香。

translations.literal: On the day before, the emperor did not hold court; the hundred officials proceeded to the West Upper Gate of the Pavilion to offer condolences, shifted formation to offer condolences to the Empress Dowager, withdrew, and went to Buddhist temples to burn incense.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve, the emperor did not hold court. Officials proceeded to the West Upper Gate Pavilion to offer condolences, then shifted formation to condole the Empress Dowager, withdrew, and went to Buddhist temples to offer incense.

sentences.zh: 凡大忌，中書悉集；
