translations.literal: For all major memorial days, the entire Secretariat assembled;
translations.idiomatic: On major memorial days, the entire Secretariat assembled;

sentences.zh: 小忌，差官一員赴寺。

translations.literal: For minor memorial days, one official was dispatched to the monastery.
translations.idiomatic: For minor memorial days, a single official was dispatched to the monastery.

sentences.zh: 如車駕巡幸道遇忌日，皆不進名奉慰。

translations.literal: If the imperial carriage on tour encountered a memorial day on the road, none submitted names to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial procession was on tour and a memorial day occurred, no condolence submissions by name were made.

sentences.zh: 留守自於寺院行香，仍不得在拜表之所。

translations.literal: The regent himself burned incense at a monastery and still could not do so at the place for presenting memorials.
translations.idiomatic: The capital regent himself offered incense at a monastery and was not permitted to do so at the memorial-submission site.

sentences.zh: 天下州府軍監亦如之。

translations.literal: All prefectures, circuits, garrisons, and superintendentancies throughout the realm followed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: The same rules applied to prefectures, circuits, garrisons, and superintendentancies throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，宣祖忌日，時明憲太后在殯，群臣止詣閣奉慰而罷行香。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, on the Xuan Ancestor's memorial day, when Empress Dowager Mingxian was still in encoffinement, the hundred officials only proceeded to the pavilion to offer condolences and ceased burning incense.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong 2, on the Xuan Ancestor's memorial day, while Empress Dowager Mingxian remained in encoffinement, officials only offered condolences at the pavilion and incense offerings were suspended.

sentences.zh: 乾德二年，禘於太廟，其日，惠明皇后忌，有司言：「唐開成四年正月二十二日祀先農，與穆宗忌同日；

translations.literal: In the second year of Qiande, at the di rite in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, that day was Empress Huiming's memorial; the relevant offices said: "In the fourth year of Kaicheng of Tang, on the twenty-second day of the first month, the sacrifice to the First Farmer fell on the same day as Emperor Muzong's memorial;
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 2, during the di rite at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the day coincided with Empress Huiming's memorial. The responsible offices noted: "In Tang Kaicheng 4, the First Farmer sacrifice on the twenty-second of the first month fell on the same day as Emperor Muzong's memorial;

sentences.zh: 太和七年十二月八日蠟百神，與敬宗忌同日。

translations.literal: On the eighth day of the twelfth month of the seventh year of Taihe, the wax offering to the Hundred Spirits fell on the same day as Emperor Jingzong's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 7, the eighth of the twelfth month, the wax offering to the Hundred Spirits likewise coincided with Emperor Jingzong's memorial.

sentences.zh: 詔以近廟忌辰，作樂非便，宜令縣而不作。

translations.literal: An edict held that because these were recent ancestral temple memorial anniversaries, making music was inconvenient, and ordered the suspended musical sets kept hung up and not played.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that because these were recent ancestral temple memorial anniversaries, music was inappropriate and the suspended musical sets should remain hung up unplayed.

sentences.zh: 竊以農、蠟之祭，猶避廟忌而不作樂，況僖祖同廟連室而在諱辰，詎可輒陳金石之奏？

translations.literal: I venture that for the agricultural and wax sacrifices, music was still avoided on temple memorial days; how much less when the Xian Ancestor shares the temple in connected chambers on a day of tabooed naming—how could metal and stone music rashly be performed?
translations.idiomatic: If even the agricultural and wax sacrifices avoided music on temple memorial days, how much more so on a tabooed day when the Xian Ancestor's spirit seat shares the temple in adjoining chambers—how could metal and stone music be performed?

sentences.zh: 伏望依禮縣而不作。」

translations.literal: I respectfully hope that according to rites the sets may be hung and not played."
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully request that, in accordance with ritual, the musical sets remain suspended unplayed.

sentences.zh: 其後，宣祖、昭憲忌日，詔准太祖、太宗奉翼祖禮，前一日更不廢務。

translations.literal: Thereafter, for the Xuan Ancestor's and Empress Zhaoxian's memorial days, an edict approved the precedent of Taizu and Taizong serving the Yi Ancestor, and no longer suspended affairs on the day before.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for the Xuan Ancestor's and Empress Zhaoxian's memorial days, an edict adopted the precedent of Taizu and Taizong honoring the Yi Ancestor, and the eve no longer required suspension of official business.

sentences.zh: 咸平中，有司將設春宴，金明池習水戲，開瓊林苑，縱都人遊賞。

translations.literal: In the Xianping period, the relevant offices were about to hold the spring banquet, drill water games at Jinming Pool, open Qionglin Garden, and allow capital residents to roam and enjoy.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianping era, officials planned a spring banquet, water games at Jinming Pool, opening Qionglin Garden, and allowing capital residents free recreation.

sentences.zh: 帝以是月太宗忌月，命詳定故事以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor because that month was Taizong's taboo month ordered that precedents be examined in detail and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Because that month was Taizong's taboo month, the emperor ordered a detailed review of precedents and a report.

sentences.zh: 史館檢討杜鎬等言：「按晉穆帝納後月，是康帝忌月，禮官荀訥議：'有忌日，無忌月；

translations.literal: Collator Du Hao and others of the Historiography Institute said: "According to the month when Emperor Mudi of Jin took a consort, which was Emperor Kangdi's taboo month, Ritual Officer Xun Ne argued: 'There are taboo days but no taboo months;
translations.idiomatic: Du Hao, Collator of the Historiography Institute, and others reported: "When Emperor Mudi of Jin took a consort, the month coincided with Emperor Kangdi's taboo month. Ritual Officer Xun Ne argued: 'There are taboo days but no taboo months;

sentences.zh: 若有忌月，即有忌時、忌歲，益無所據。

translations.literal: if there were taboo months, there would also be taboo hours and taboo years, which would be even more without basis.
translations.idiomatic: if taboo months existed, there would also be taboo hours and taboo years, for which there is even less justification.

sentences.zh: '當時從訥所議。

translations.literal: At the time Ne's argument was followed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Ne's argument was adopted.

sentences.zh: 唐武后神功元年，建安王攸宜破契丹，詣闕獻捷，軍人入城，例有軍樂，內史王及善以國家忌月，請備而不奏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shengong under Empress Wu of Tang, Prince of Jian'an Youyi defeated the Khitan, came to court to present victory, and when the troops entered the city there was customarily military music; Grand Secretary Wang Jishan, citing the state's taboo month, requested that it be prepared but not performed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tang Shengong 1, Prince of Jian'an Youyi defeated the Khitan and came to court to report victory. When the troops entered the city, military music was customary, but Grand Secretary Wang Jishan, citing the state's taboo month, requested that it be prepared but not played.

sentences.zh: 鳳閣侍郎王方慶奏：'按《禮經》，有忌日而無忌月。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Phoenix Pavilion Wang Fangqing memorialized: 'According to the Classic of Rites, there are taboo days but no taboo months.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Wang Fangqing of the Phoenix Pavilion memorialized: 'According to the Classic of Rites, there are taboo days but no taboo months.

sentences.zh: '遂舉樂。

translations.literal: Music was then performed.
translations.idiomatic: Music was then performed.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，太常博士韋公肅言：「《禮》無忌月禁樂，今太常教坊以正月為忌月，停郊廟饗宴之禮，中外士庶咸罷宴樂，竊恐乖宜。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xianzong, Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Gongsu said: "The Rites contain no prohibition of music in taboo months; now the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Music Office treat the first month as a taboo month, suspend suburban and temple feasting rites, and both inside and outside the court scholars and commoners all cease banquets and music—I fear this is inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xianzong, Wei Gongsu, Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, said: "The Rites contain no prohibition of music in taboo months; yet the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Music Office now treat the first month as a taboo month, suspend suburban and temple feasts, and ban banquets and music throughout court and society—I fear this is inappropriate.

sentences.zh: '時依公肅所奏。

translations.literal: At the time Gongsu's memorial was followed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Gongsu's memorial was adopted.

sentences.zh: 伏以忌日不樂，嘗載《禮經》；

translations.literal: I respectfully note that abstaining from music on taboo days is recorded in the Classic of Rites;
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully note that abstaining from music on taboo days is recorded in the Classic of Rites;

sentences.zh: 忌月徹縣，實無典故。

translations.literal: removing the suspended musical sets in taboo months truly has no historical precedent.
translations.idiomatic: suspending musical sets in taboo months has no genuine historical precedent.

sentences.zh: 況前代鴻儒，議論足據。

translations.literal: Moreover, eminent scholars of former ages offer arguments sufficient to rely upon.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, eminent scholars of earlier ages provide ample precedent.

sentences.zh: 其春宴及池苑，併合舉樂。」

translations.literal: The spring banquet and the pool and garden should together have music performed."
translations.idiomatic: The spring banquet and the pool and garden festivities should all proceed with music."

sentences.zh: 景德元年，北征凱旋京師，是日，以懿德皇后忌，詔徹鹵簿、鼓吹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingde, returning in triumph to the capital from the northern campaign, that day being Empress Yide's memorial, an edict ordered the honor guard and martial music withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 1, upon returning in triumph to the capital from the northern campaign, the day coincided with Empress Yide's memorial, and an edict ordered the honor guard and martial music withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 禮官議曰：「班師振旅，國之大事，後之忌日，家之私事。

translations.literal: Ritual officers deliberated: "Returning the army and marshaling the troops is a great affair of state; an empress's memorial day is a private family matter.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers argued: "Returning the army in triumph is a great affair of state; an empress's memorial day is a private family matter.

sentences.zh: 今大賀凱旋，軍容宜肅。

translations.literal: Now in great celebration of triumph, the military array should be solemn.
translations.idiomatic: Now, in grand celebration of victory, the military procession should be solemn.

sentences.zh: 昔武王伐紂在諒沍中，猶前歌後舞。

translations.literal: Formerly King Wu's campaign against Zhou occurred during the mourning period, yet there was singing in front and dancing behind.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, King Wu's campaign against Zhou took place during the mourning period, yet there was singing in front and dancing behind.

sentences.zh: 夫諒沍是重，遠忌是輕，以此而論，舉樂無爽。

translations.literal: Mourning is weighty and a distant memorial is light; judged by this, performing music would be without error.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning is weighty and a distant memorial is comparatively light; on this basis, performing music would be without impropriety.

sentences.zh: 況《春秋》之義，不以家事辭王事，其還京日，法駕、鼓吹、音樂，並請振作。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is not to decline royal affairs because of family affairs; on the day of return to the capital, the imperial carriage, martial music, and ceremonial music should all be requested to be restored."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the Spring and Autumn Annals teach that royal affairs should not be set aside for family matters; on the day of return to the capital, the imperial carriage, martial music, and ceremonial music should all be restored."

sentences.zh: 尋詔：「自今宗廟忌日，西京及諸節鎮給錢十千，防禦、團練州七千，軍事州五千，以備齋設。」

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter an edict stated: "From now on, on ancestral temple memorial days, the Western Capital and all military commissions shall be granted ten thousand cash, defense and training prefectures seven thousand, and military prefectures five thousand, to provide for vegetarian offerings."
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter an edict ordered: "Henceforth on ancestral temple memorial days, the Western Capital and all military commissions shall receive ten thousand cash, defense and training prefectures seven thousand, and military prefectures five thousand, to fund vegetarian offerings.

sentences.zh: 元德皇后忌日，舊制，樞密使依內諸司例，惟進名，不赴行香，知樞密院王欽若以為言。

translations.literal: On Empress Yuande's memorial day, by old regulation the Commissioner of Military Affairs, following the precedent of inner bureaus, only submitted a name and did not attend to burn incense; Wang Qinruo, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, raised the matter.
translations.idiomatic: On Empress Yuande's memorial day, by old regulation the Commissioner of Military Affairs, following inner bureau precedent, only submitted a name and did not attend incense offerings; Wang Qinruo, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, raised objections.

sentences.zh: 自是，三司使副、翰林樞密龍圖直學士並赴焉。

translations.literal: From this, the deputy commissioners of the Three Departments, Hanlin, Military Affairs, and Longtu Academicians all attended.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, deputy commissioners of the Three Departments, Hanlin, Military Affairs, and Longtu Academicians all attended.

sentences.zh: 真宗崩，元德、明德皇后忌日在禫制內，乃停進名行香。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhenzong died, the memorial days of Empresses Yuande and Mingde fell within the chan mourning period, and submission of names and burning incense were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong died, the memorial days of Empresses Yuande and Mingde fell within the chan mourning period, and name submissions and incense offerings were suspended.

sentences.zh: 凡奉慰，宰相、樞密使各帥百官、內職共進名，節度使、留後、觀察使各進名。

translations.literal: For all condolence offerings, the chief councillors and commissioners of military affairs each led the hundred officials and inner service personnel in jointly submitting names; military commissioners, acting commissioners, and observation commissioners each submitted names.
translations.idiomatic: For all condolence offerings, chief councillors and military commissioners each led officials and inner service personnel in joint name submissions; military commissioners, acting commissioners, and observation commissioners each submitted names separately.

sentences.zh: 忌日前後，各禁刑三日如天慶節，釋杖以下情輕者，復斷屠宰，不視事前後各三日，禁樂各五日。

translations.literal: Before and after memorial days, punishments were each forbidden for three days as on the Tianqing Festival; for lighter cases below release from the cudgel, slaughter was again forbidden; non-attendance to affairs three days before and after; music forbidden five days each.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after memorial days, punishments were forbidden for three days as on the Tianqing Festival; lighter cases below release from the cudgel were exempted; slaughter was again prohibited; official business was suspended for three days before and after; and music was forbidden for five days.

sentences.zh: 其後，以歲月漸遠，禁刑、不視事各二日，禁樂各三日。

translations.literal: Thereafter, as years gradually passed, prohibition of punishments and non-attendance to affairs were each reduced to two days, and prohibition of music to three days each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, as time passed, prohibition of punishments and suspension of official business were each reduced to two days, and prohibition of music to three days.

sentences.zh: 章憲明肅太后忌辰，禮官請依章懿太后禮例，前後各二日不視事，一日禁屠宰，各三日禁樂。

translations.literal: On the memorial anniversary of Empress Dowager Zhangxian Mingsu, ritual officers requested following the ritual precedent of Empress Dowager Zhangyi: two days before and after without attending to affairs, one day prohibiting slaughter, and three days each prohibiting music.
translations.idiomatic: On Empress Dowager Zhangxian Mingsu's memorial anniversary, ritual officers requested following Empress Dowager Zhangyi's precedent: two days before and after without attending to affairs, one day prohibiting slaughter, and three days prohibiting music.

sentences.zh: 詔：應大忌日，行香，臣僚並素食。

translations.literal: An edict stated: On all major memorial days when burning incense, officials and staff shall all eat vegetarian food.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: On all major memorial days when incense was offered, officials and staff were to eat vegetarian food.

sentences.zh: 復立孝惠、孝章、淑德、章懷、章惠、溫成諸後為小忌，未幾，罷。

translations.literal: The empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, Zhanghuai, Zhanghui, and Wencheng were again established as minor memorial days; before long, this was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Empresses Xiaohui, Xiaozhang, Shude, Zhanghuai, Zhanghui, and Wencheng were again designated minor memorial days; before long, the practice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，太常禮院言：「僖祖及文懿皇后神主既祧，准禮不諱，忌日亦請依唐睿宗祧遷故事廢之。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Shenzong acceded, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Institute said: "Since the spirit tablets of the Xian Ancestor and Empress Wanyi have been removed to distant storage, according to rites there is no taboo; the memorial days also request following the Tang precedent of Emperor Ruizong's removal and abolition."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shenzong acceded, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Ritual Institute reported: "Since the spirit tablets of the Xian Ancestor and Empress Wanyi have been removed to distant storage, taboo no longer applies; we request that their memorial days be abolished following the Tang precedent of Emperor Ruizong's removal."

sentences.zh: 初，神禦殿酌獻，設皇帝位於庭下，而忌日兩府列於殿上；

translations.literal: Initially, at libation offerings in the Hall of Imperial Spirits, the emperor's seat was set below the courtyard, while on memorial days the two departments lined up on the hall above;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, at libation offerings in the Hall of Imperial Spirits, the emperor's seat was placed in the courtyard below, while on memorial days the two departments lined up on the hall above;

sentences.zh: 寺院行香，左右巡使、兩赤縣令于中門相向分立，俟宰臣至，立位前，直省官贊通揖，於禮無據。

translations.literal: at monasteries for burning incense, the left and right patrol commissioners and the magistrates of the two red counties stood facing each other at the middle gate, waited until chief councillors arrived, stood before their positions, and direct-service officials announced mutual bows—all without basis in rites.
translations.idiomatic: at monasteries for incense offerings, left and right patrol commissioners and the magistrates of the two red counties stood facing each other at the middle gate, waited for chief councillors to arrive, stood before their positions, and direct-service officials announced mutual bows—all without ritual basis.

sentences.zh: 乃命行香群臣班殿下，宰相一員升殿跪爐，而罷通揖。

translations.literal: Thereupon it was ordered that officials burning incense form ranks below the hall, one chief councillor ascend the hall and kneel at the censer, and mutual bows be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon officials offering incense were ordered to form ranks below the hall, one chief councillor to ascend and kneel at the censer, and mutual bows were abolished.

sentences.zh: 又詔：大忌日不為假，執政官蚤出。

translations.literal: Another edict stated: On major memorial days no leave is granted; executive officials depart early.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered: On major memorial days no leave was granted; executive officials departed early.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「順祖及惠明皇后既葬遷主，罷行香。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "Since the Shun Ancestor and Empress Huiming have been buried and their spirit tablets moved, burning incense is abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites reported: "Since the Shun Ancestor and Empress Huiming have been buried and their spirit tablets moved, incense offerings are abolished.

sentences.zh: 忌日，請於永昌院佛殿之東張幄齋薦。」

translations.literal: On memorial days, we request erecting a canopy east of the Buddha hall at Yongchang Cloister for vegetarian offerings."
translations.idiomatic: On memorial days, we request erecting a canopy east of the Buddha hall at Yongchang Cloister for vegetarian offerings.

sentences.zh: 乃詔：「僖祖、翼祖並後六位忌日鹹如之。」

translations.literal: An edict then stated: "The Xian Ancestor, Yi Ancestor, and the six empresses' memorial days shall all follow likewise."
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered: "The Xian Ancestor, Yi Ancestor, and the six empresses' memorial days shall all follow the same arrangement.

sentences.zh: 先是，翼祖、簡穆皇后神主奉藏夾室，依禮不忌。

translations.literal: Previously, the spirit tablets of the Yi Ancestor and Empress Jianmu had been stored in the side chamber, and according to rites there was no taboo.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the spirit tablets of the Yi Ancestor and Empress Jianmu had been stored in the side chamber, and according to rites no taboo applied.

sentences.zh: 後復詔還本室，而忌日亦如舊焉。

translations.literal: Later an edict again ordered them returned to the original chamber, and memorial days likewise reverted to the old practice.
translations.idiomatic: Later an edict ordered them returned to the original chamber, and memorial days likewise reverted to the former practice.

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：群臣進名奉慰，其日質明，文武朝參官入詣朝堂就次。

translations.literal: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: For officials' submission of names in condolence, at dawn that day civil and military court-attending officials entered and proceeded to the court hall to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of the Zhenghe Era: For officials' condolence submissions by name, at dawn that day civil and military court-attending officials entered the court hall and took their places.

sentences.zh: 御史台先引殿中侍御史一員入就位，次西上閣門、御史台分引朝參官及諸軍將校，次禮直官引三公以下在西上閣門南階下，每等重行異位，並北向東上。

translations.literal: The Censorate first led one palace attendant censor in to take position; next the West Upper Gate of the Pavilion and the Censorate separately led court-attending officials and military officers of the various armies; next ritual attendants led the Three Excellencies and below to the south steps of the West Upper Gate of the Pavilion, each rank in double rows at separate positions, all facing north and ascending eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate first led one palace attendant censor to take position; then the West Upper Gate Pavilion and Censorate separately led court-attending officials and military officers; then ritual attendants led the Three Excellencies and below to the south steps of the West Upper Gate Pavilion, each rank in double rows at separate positions, all facing north and ascending eastward.

sentences.zh: 知西上閣門官于班前西向立，搢笏，執名紙，躬。

translations.literal: The official in charge of the West Upper Gate of the Pavilion stood west-facing before the ranks, inserted his tablet, held the name paper, and bowed.
translations.idiomatic: The official in charge of the West Upper Gate Pavilion stood facing west before the ranks, inserted his tablet, held the name paper, and bowed.

sentences.zh: 三公以下文武百僚俱再拜，俊閣門官執笏、置名紙笏上、入西上閣門訖，退。

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies and below, all civil and military officials, together bowed twice; then the pavilion official held his tablet, placed the name paper on the tablet, entered the West Upper Gate of the Pavilion, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies and below, all civil and military officials, bowed twice together; then the pavilion official held his tablet, placed the name paper upon it, entered the West Upper Gate Pavilion, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 群臣奉慰詣景靈宮，每等重行異位，並北向東上。

translations.literal: Officials offering condolences proceeded to Jingling Palace; each rank in double rows at separate positions, all facing north and ascending eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Officials offering condolences proceeded to Jingling Palace, each rank in double rows at separate positions, all facing north and ascending eastward.

sentences.zh: 禮直官揖班首以下再拜訖，引班首自東階升殿，舍人接引同升，詣香案前，搢笏，上香，跪奠茶訖，執笏興，降階復位，又再拜；

translations.literal: Ritual attendants bowed to the rank leader and below until they had bowed twice; led the rank leader up the east steps to the hall, ushers guided them up together, proceeded before the incense table, inserted tablets, offered incense, knelt and presented tea, then took up tablets and rose, descended the steps and returned to position, and bowed twice again;
translations.idiomatic: Ritual attendants bowed to the rank leader and below until all had bowed twice; led the rank leader up the east steps, ushers guided them together to the incense table, where they inserted tablets, offered incense, knelt and presented tea, then rose, descended, returned to position, and bowed twice again;

sentences.zh: 次引班首以下分左右搢笏，行香，宰相、執政官分左右行香訖，執笏俱復位；

translations.literal: next led the rank leader and below to left and right to insert tablets and burn incense; chief councillors and executive officials burned incense left and right, then all took up tablets and returned to position;
translations.idiomatic: next led the rank leader and below to left and right to insert tablets and offer incense; chief councillors and executive officials offered incense on left and right, then all returned to position;

sentences.zh: 次引班首升殿，詣香案前俯伏，跪，搢笏，執爐，俟讀疏畢，執笏俯伏，興，降階復位，又再拜，退。

translations.literal: next led the rank leader up the hall, to prostrate before the incense table, kneel, insert tablet, hold the censer, wait until the memorial text was read, take up tablet and prostrate, rise, descend the steps and return to position, bow twice again, and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: next led the rank leader up the hall to prostrate before the incense table, kneel, insert his tablet, hold the censer, wait until the memorial text was read, rise, descend, return to position, bow twice again, and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 中興之制：忌日，百僚行香，在外州軍亦詣寺院行香，如在以日易月服制之內，並依禮例權停。

translations.literal: Regulations of the Restoration: On memorial days, the hundred officials burn incense; officials in outer prefectures and garrisons also proceed to monasteries to burn incense; if within the mourning system of substituting days for months, all are provisionally suspended according to ritual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations of the Restoration: On memorial days, officials offered incense; officials in outer prefectures and garrisons also proceeded to monasteries; if within the mourning system of substituting days for months, all were provisionally suspended according to ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 大祥後次年，於曆日內箋注立忌辰，禁音樂一日。

translations.literal: In the year after the great auspicious rite, within the calendar a memorial anniversary was noted and established, and music was forbidden for one day.
translations.idiomatic: In the year after the great auspicious rite, a memorial anniversary was noted on the calendar, and music was forbidden for one day.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年二月，太常少卿蘇遲等以徽宗、欽宗留北，有朔望遙拜之禮，乃言：「凡遇祖宗帝后忌，前一日並忌日，皇帝自內先服紅袍遙拜訖，易服行禮。」

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shaoxing, Vice Director Su Chi and others, because Emperors Huizong and Qinzong remained in the north and there was the rite of distant bowing on new and full moons, said: "Whenever ancestral emperors' and empresses' memorials occur, on the day before and on the memorial day itself, the emperor from the inner palace first wears a red robe and completes distant bowing, then changes dress to perform the rites."
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 1, second month, Vice Director Su Chi and others, noting that Emperors Huizong and Qinzong remained in the north and that distant bowing on new and full moons was observed, reported: "Whenever ancestral emperors' and empresses' memorials occur, on the eve and on the memorial day itself, the emperor should first wear a red robe in the inner palace and complete distant bowing, then change dress to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，詔：「應諸路州、軍見屯軍馬統兵官，每遇國忌，免行香。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, an edict stated: "All commanding officers of stationed troops in prefectures and garrisons on the various circuits shall be exempt from burning incense on each state memorial day."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, eighth month, an edict ordered: "All commanding officers of stationed troops in prefectures and garrisons on the various circuits shall be exempt from incense offerings on state memorial days."

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，御史台言：「正月十三日，欽聖憲肅皇后忌，其日立春。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, the Censorate said: "On the thirteenth day of the first month is Empress Qinsheng Xiansu's memorial, and that day is the Beginning of Spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, first month, the Censorate reported: "The thirteenth of the first month is Empress Qinsheng Xiansu's memorial, and that day is also the Beginning of Spring.

sentences.zh: 准令，諸臣僚及將校立春日賜幡勝，遇稱賀等拜表、忌辰奉慰退即戴。

translations.literal: According to regulations, all officials and military officers on the Beginning of Spring are granted streamers and victory pennants; when encountering congratulatory memorials and the like, or after submitting memorials and offering condolences on memorial anniversaries, they immediately don them.
translations.idiomatic: According to regulations, officials and military officers receive streamers and victory pennants on the Beginning of Spring and don them immediately after congratulatory memorials or after submitting memorials and offering condolences on memorial anniversaries.

sentences.zh: 欲乞候十三日忌辰行香退，即行戴插。」

translations.literal: We request that after withdrawing from burning incense on the thirteenth, the memorial anniversary, they then don and insert them."
translations.idiomatic: We request that pennants be donned only after incense offerings on the thirteenth, the memorial anniversary, have concluded.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 三十一年六月，禮部侍郎金安節等言：「六月二十八日，欽慈皇后忌辰，系在淵聖皇帝以日易月釋服之外，百官行香，宜如常制。」

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-first year, Vice Minister of Rites Jin Anjie and others said: "On the twenty-eighth day of the sixth month is Empress Qinci's memorial anniversary, which falls outside the release from mourning of the Substituting-Days-for-Months system for Emperor Yuansheng; officials burning incense should follow the regular regulation."
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, sixth month, Vice Minister Jin Anjie of the Ministry of Rites and others reported: "The twenty-eighth of the sixth month is Empress Qinci's memorial anniversary, which falls outside Emperor Yuansheng's release from the substituting-days-for-months mourning; officials' incense offerings should follow regular procedure.

sentences.zh: 詔依。

translations.literal: An edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 三十二年正月，禮部、太常寺言：「已降旨：欽宗祔廟，翼祖當遷。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirty-second year, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said: "An order has already been issued: with Emperor Qinzong's enshrinement in the temple, the Yi Ancestor should be moved.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year, first month, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported: "An order has already been issued: with Emperor Qinzong's enshrinement in the temple, the Yi Ancestor must be moved.

sentences.zh: 於正月九日告遷翼祖皇帝、簡穆皇后神主奉藏於夾室，所有以後翼祖皇帝忌及諱、簡穆皇后忌，欲乞依禮不諱、不忌。」

translations.literal: On the ninth day of the first month announce the move of the spirit tablets of the Yi Ancestor and Empress Jianmu for storage in the side chamber; for all future memorial days and tabooed names of the Yi Ancestor and memorial days of Empress Jianmu, we request that according to rites there be no taboo and no memorial observance."
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth of the first month, announce the move of the Yi Ancestor's and Empress Jianmu's spirit tablets to the side chamber; for all future tabooed names and memorial days of the Yi Ancestor and memorial days of Empress Jianmu, we request that taboo and memorial observance no longer apply, in accordance with rites.

sentences.zh: 詔恭依。

translations.literal: An edict respectfully approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court respectfully approved.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年十一月詔：「文武百僚詣景靈宮國忌立班行香，自今如遇宰執俱致齋不及趁赴，于東班從上引官一員升殿跪爐行香，以次官一員詣西班行香。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Chunxi, an edict stated: "When civil and military officials proceed to Jingling Palace to form ranks and burn incense on state memorial days, from now on if chief councillors and executive officials are all observing fasts and cannot attend in time, one usher from the top of the east ranks shall ascend the hall and kneel at the censer to burn incense, and one official next in rank shall proceed to the west ranks to burn incense."
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 1, eleventh month, an edict ordered: "When civil and military officials proceed to Jingling Palace to form ranks and offer incense on state memorial days, if chief councillors and executive officials are all observing fasts and cannot attend, one usher from the top of the east ranks shall ascend and kneel at the censer, and one official next in rank shall offer incense on the west side.

sentences.zh: 先是，閣門得旨：國忌行香，宰執致齋不赴，其西壁武臣闕官押班，已降指揮，差使相或太尉、節度使等押班，可令文武班內班上一員東壁押班，止令西壁散香，今後准此。

translations.literal: Previously, the Pavilion Gate received an order: on state memorial days for burning incense, when chief councillors observing fasts did not attend and the west side lacked a military official to lead the ranks, orders had already been issued dispatching a envoy-minister or grand marshal, military commissioner, and the like to lead ranks; it was possible to have one official from the inner ranks of the civil and military formations lead ranks on the east wall, and only have the west side scatter incense—hereafter this shall be the standard.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, the Pavilion Gate received orders that when chief councillors observing fasts did not attend state memorial incense offerings and the west side lacked a military official to lead ranks, envoy-ministers, grand marshals, or military commissioners were dispatched; one inner-rank official from the civil and military formations could lead the east side, with incense scattered only on the west—this became the standard.

sentences.zh: 至是，禮部、太常寺重別指定來上，故有是命。

translations.literal: At this point, the Ministry of Rites and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices again separately specified and submitted regulations, hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: At this point, the Ministry of Rites and Court of Imperial Sacrifices resubmitted revised specifications, hence this order.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，太常少卿齊慶胄言：「每遇國忌，文臣班列莫敢不肅，唯是武臣一班員數絕少，或以疾病在告，多不趁赴。」

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Vice Director Qi Qingzhou said: "Whenever state memorial days occur, the civil officials' ranks dare not be lax; only the military officials' single rank has extremely few members, and some, citing illness and leave, mostly fail to attend in time."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, tenth month, Vice Director Qi Qingzhou reported: "On state memorial days, civil officials' ranks are invariably solemn; only the military rank has very few members, and many fail to attend, citing illness and leave.

sentences.zh: 詔閣門、御史台申嚴行下，如有違戾，彈劾聞奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Pavilion Gate and Censorate strictly to promulgate this; if there were violations, to impeach and report.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Pavilion Gate and Censorate to enforce this strictly; violators were to be impeached and reported.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，侍御史張大經奏：「比來國忌行香日分，合赴官類多托疾在告，以免夙興拜跪之勞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, Attending Censor Zhang Dajing memorialized: "Recently on state memorial days for burning incense, officials due to attend mostly claim illness and leave to avoid the labor of rising early to bow and kneel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, tenth month, Attending Censor Zhang Dajing memorialized: "Recently on state memorial incense days, officials due to attend mostly claim illness and leave to avoid rising early to bow and kneel.

sentences.zh: 乞自今如遇行香日，有稱疾托故不赴者，從本台彈奏，乞置典憲。」

translations.literal: We request that from now on, whenever on incense days there are those who claim illness or invent excuses and fail to attend, this Censorate shall impeach them, and we request that statutory penalties be established."
translations.idiomatic: We request that henceforth, whenever officials claim illness or invent excuses to avoid incense days, this Censorate shall impeach them, and statutory penalties be established.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 群臣私忌。

translations.literal: Officials' private memorial days.
translations.idiomatic: Officials' private memorial days.

sentences.zh: 開寶敕文：「應常參官及內殿起居職官等，自今刺史、郎中、將軍以下遇私忌，請准式假一日。

translations.literal: Kaibao edict text: "All regular-attendance officials and inner-hall audience officials, from now on when prefects, bureau directors, generals, and below encounter private memorial days, request leave of one day according to formula.
translations.idiomatic: Kaibao edict: "All regular-attendance officials and inner-hall audience officials—from prefects, bureau directors, and generals downward—shall receive one day's leave according to formula on private memorial days.

sentences.zh: 忌前之夕，聽還私第。」

translations.literal: On the eve before the memorial, they are permitted to return to their private residences."
translations.idiomatic: On the eve before the memorial, they were permitted to return to their private residences.

sentences.zh: 其後有司言：「臣僚忌日恩賜，其間甚有無名者：如劉繼元、李煜、劉鋹之類，皆身為降俘，亡沒已久，而尚沾恩賜；

translations.literal: Thereafter the relevant offices said: "Among the memorial-day favors granted to officials, many are utterly unwarranted: such as Liu Jiyuan, Li Yu, Liu Chang, and the like—all were themselves surrendered captives, long dead, yet still receive favored grants;
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the responsible offices reported: "Among memorial-day favors granted to officials, many are unwarranted: Liu Jiyuan, Li Yu, Liu Chang, and the like were all surrendered captives long dead, yet still receive favored grants;

sentences.zh: 及周朝忌日，尚有追薦；

translations.literal: and on Zhou dynasty memorial days there are still supplemental offerings;
translations.idiomatic: and on Zhou dynasty memorial days supplemental offerings are still made;

sentences.zh: 本朝亦有追尊皇后生日道場，並諸神祠亦有為生日者。

translations.literal: our dynasty also has repentance altars for posthumously honored empresses' birthdays, and various spirit shrines also observe birthdays.
translations.idiomatic: our dynasty also holds repentance altars for the birthdays of posthumously honored empresses, and various spirit shrines likewise observe birthdays.

sentences.zh: 請付禮官詳議，不經之物，一切省去。」

translations.literal: We request that rites officials deliberate in detail and eliminate all uncanonical items."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that rites officials deliberate in detail and eliminate every uncanonical practice.

sentences.zh: 詔周朝忌日仍舊，餘罷之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Zhou dynasty memorial days remain as before; the rest were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Zhou dynasty memorial days remain unchanged; all the rest were abolished.
